(function () {
  var overlay   = document.getElementById('brShareOverlay');
  var modal     = document.getElementById('brShareModal');
  var previewImg  = document.getElementById('brSharePreviewImg');
  var previewName = document.getElementById('brSharePreviewName');
  var previewSlug = document.getElementById('brSharePreviewSlug');
  var copyBtn   = document.getElementById('brShareCopyBtn');
  var copyLbl   = document.getElementById('brShareCopyLabel');
  var waLink    = document.getElementById('brShareWa');
  var xLink     = document.getElementById('brShareX');
  var liLink    = document.getElementById('brShareLi');
  var fbLink    = document.getElementById('brShareFb');
  var mailLink  = document.getElementById('brShareMail');
  var qrImg     = document.getElementById('brShareQr');
  var qrWrap    = document.getElementById('brShareQrWrap');
  var qrToggle  = document.getElementById('brShareQrToggleBtn');
  var qrToggleLbl = document.getElementById('brShareQrToggleLabel');
  var nativeBtn = document.getElementById('brShareNativeBtn');
  if (!modal) return;

  var shareUrl = '';

  window.brShareOpen = function (brand) {
    var main = document.querySelector('main.bpr-page');
    var name = brand || (main && main.getAttribute('data-brand-name')) || 'this brand';

    shareUrl = window.location.href.split('#')[0];
    var slugText = shareUrl.replace(/^https?:\/\//, '').replace(/\/$/, '');

    var text     = 'Check out ' + name + ' on Ghar.tv';
    var encUrl   = encodeURIComponent(shareUrl);
    var encText  = encodeURIComponent(text);
    var encBoth  = encodeURIComponent(text + ': ' + shareUrl);

    var heroImg = main && main.getAttribute('data-brand-share-image');
    var isLogo  = false;
    if (!heroImg) {
      var heroEl = document.querySelector('.bpr-hero__bg img');
      if (heroEl) heroImg = heroEl.getAttribute('src');
    }
    if (!heroImg) {
      var logoEl = document.querySelector('.bpr-hero__logo img');
      if (logoEl) { heroImg = logoEl.getAttribute('src'); isLogo = true; }
    }
    var previewMedia = previewImg.parentNode;
    previewMedia.classList.toggle('bsm-preview__media--logo', isLogo);
    if (heroImg) previewMedia.removeAttribute('hidden');
    else         previewMedia.setAttribute('hidden', '');
    previewImg.src = heroImg || '';
    previewImg.alt = name;
    previewName.textContent = name;
    previewSlug.textContent = slugText;

    qrImg.src = 'https://api.qrserver.com/v1/create-qr-code/?size=360x360&margin=8&data=' + encUrl;
    qrImg.alt = 'QR code for ' + name;

    waLink.href   = 'https://wa.me/?text=' + encBoth;
    xLink.href    = 'https://twitter.com/intent/tweet?text=' + encText + '&url=' + encUrl;
    liLink.href   = 'https://www.linkedin.com/sharing/share-offsite/?url=' + encUrl;
    fbLink.href   = 'https://www.facebook.com/sharer/sharer.php?u=' + encUrl;
    mailLink.href = 'mailto:?subject=' + encodeURIComponent(name + ' on Ghar.tv') + '&body=' + encBoth;

    if ('share' in navigator) nativeBtn.removeAttribute('hidden');
    else nativeBtn.setAttribute('hidden', '');

    qrWrap.setAttribute('hidden', '');
    qrToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    qrToggleLbl.textContent = 'Show QR code';

    overlay.classList.add('jm-open');
    modal.classList.add('jm-open');
  };

  window.brShareClose = function () {
    overlay.classList.remove('jm-open');
    modal.classList.remove('jm-open');
  };

  window.brShareCopy = function () {
    if (!shareUrl) return;
    function flash() {
      copyBtn.setAttribute('data-copied', '');
      copyLbl.textContent = 'Copied';
      setTimeout(function () {
        copyBtn.removeAttribute('data-copied');
        copyLbl.textContent = 'Copy link';
      }, 1600);
    }
    if (navigator.clipboard && window.isSecureContext) {
      navigator.clipboard.writeText(shareUrl).then(flash).catch(function () {
        var t = document.createElement('textarea');
        t.value = shareUrl; document.body.appendChild(t);
        t.select(); try { document.execCommand('copy'); } catch (e) {}
        document.body.removeChild(t); flash();
      });
    } else {
      var t = document.createElement('textarea');
      t.value = shareUrl; document.body.appendChild(t);
      t.select(); try { document.execCommand('copy'); flash(); } catch (e) {}
      document.body.removeChild(t);
    }
  };

  window.brShareQrToggle = function () {
    var isHidden = qrWrap.hasAttribute('hidden');
    if (isHidden) {
      qrWrap.removeAttribute('hidden');
      qrToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
      qrToggleLbl.textContent = 'Hide QR code';
    } else {
      qrWrap.setAttribute('hidden', '');
      qrToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      qrToggleLbl.textContent = 'Show QR code';
    }
  };

  window.brShareNative = function () {
    if (!('share' in navigator)) return;
    navigator.share({
      title: previewName.textContent + ' on Ghar.tv',
      text: 'Check out ' + previewName.textContent + ' on Ghar.tv',
      url: shareUrl
    }).catch(function () {});
  };

  document.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
    var trig = e.target.closest('[data-brand-share]');
    if (!trig) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    window.brShareOpen(trig.getAttribute('data-brand'));
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && modal.classList.contains('jm-open')) brShareClose();
  });
})();

Use it when

  • The Share button in the profile topbar, or anywhere else on a brand or person profile: add data-brand-share and data-brand="Brand Name" to a button
  • Exactly one #brShareModal per page, after </main>, wired by the script below

Avoid

  • Portal pages that are not profiles. They use the drop-in [data-share] sheet from /ghar-share.js instead
  • Pasting it into a new tenant. Brand tenants start from _dev/templates/brand-profile-{family}.html via the brand-profile-work skill or /new-brand-profile, and person pages come from npm run build:people; both already carry the sheet
  • Re-adding page-local #brShareModal or .bsm-* CSS. The chassis now lives in styles.min.css on the jm-modal jm-size-md classes; the inline copies are the debt Phase 1 is removing
  • Letting dark-tenant tokens reach it. The sheet stays light on dark tenants, which works only because tenant token overrides are scoped to main.bpr-page
  • An avatar, a photo of a person, or a brand tint on the preview card beyond the resolved share image

API

NameTypeWhat it does
[data-brand-share]attributeAny clicked element carrying it opens the sheet. Pair with data-brand="Brand Name" for the preview name and share text.
data-brand-share-imageattributeOn main.bpr-page. First choice for the preview image; then .bpr-hero__bg img; then .bpr-hero__logo img (shown as a logo tile). With none, the tile is hidden.
data-brand-nameattributeOn main.bpr-page. Fallback name when the trigger has no data-brand.
brShareOpen(brand)JSOpens the sheet for the current URL (hash stripped), filling the preview, tiles, QR and native button.
brShareClose()JSCloses it. Also bound to the overlay, the close button and Escape.
brShareCopy()JSCopies the URL, with an execCommand fallback, and flashes Copied on the tile for 1.6s.
brShareQrToggle()JSShows or hides the QR panel. It resets to hidden on every open.
brShareNative()JSnavigator.share(). The button is only unhidden when the browser supports it.
.jm-modal.jm-size-mdclassThe shared modal chassis the sheet sits on; its #brShareModal refinements are in styles.min.css.
.bsm-previewclassDark preview card: media slot, name, and the domain-style URL.
.bsm-tilesclassGrid of .bsm-tile buttons and links, one modifier per channel (--copy, --wa, --x, --fb, --li, --mail).

Source _dev/reference/components/profile-share-sheet.html

.bpr-topbar { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 50; height: var(--bpr-bar-rest, 84px); background: transparent; border-bottom: 1px solid transparent; transition: background .3s ease, backdrop-filter .3s ease, border-color .3s ease, height .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); }
body[data-scrolled] .bpr-topbar { height: 56px; }
.bpr-topbar__inner { max-width: var(--max-w); margin: 0 auto; height: 100%; padding: 0 var(--pad-h); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px; }
.bpr-topbar__left { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px; flex: 0 0 auto; min-width: 0; }
.bpr-topbar__mark { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; line-height: 1; min-width: 0; }
.bpr-topbar__mark-home { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; text-decoration: none; color: #fff; transition: color .3s ease; }
.bpr-topbar__mark-glyph { display: block; height: 22px; width: auto; }
.bpr-topbar__mark-vertical { font: 600 16px/1.35 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.01em; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; transition: color .3s ease, opacity .18s ease; position: relative; padding-left: 10px; }
.bpr-topbar__mark-vertical::before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); height: 18px; width: 1px; background: currentColor; opacity: .5; pointer-events: none; }
.bpr-topbar__mark-vertical:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; }
.bpr-topbar__mark-home:focus-visible, .bpr-topbar__mark-vertical:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #fff; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 3px; }
.bpr-topbar__tabs { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; max-width: var(--max-w); margin: 0 auto; padding: 10px var(--pad-h); overflow-x: auto; overflow-y: hidden; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch; scrollbar-width: none; }
.bpr-topbar__tabs::-webkit-scrollbar { display: none; }
.bpr-topbar__tabs a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; font: 500 13px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--muted); text-decoration: none; white-space: nowrap; transition: background .22s ease, color .22s ease; }
.bpr-topbar__tabs a:hover { background: var(--brand-soft, rgba(26,23,20,.06)); color: var(--brand, var(--ink)); }
.bpr-topbar__tabs a.is-active { background: var(--brand, var(--ink)); color: #fff; font-weight: 600; }
.bpr-topbar__subnav { position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0; z-index: 51; background: #ffffff; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(26,23,20,.18); transform: translateY(-100%); opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
body[data-past-hero] .bpr-topbar__subnav { transform: translateY(0); opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; transition: transform .32s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), opacity .28s ease, top .32s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); }
body[data-past-hero]:not([data-nav-hidden]) .bpr-topbar__subnav { top: 56px; }
.bpr-topbar { transition: background .3s ease, backdrop-filter .3s ease, border-color .3s ease, height .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), transform .32s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); }
@media (max-width: 767px) {
  .bpr-topbar__subnav { display: none; }
  body[data-nav-hidden] .bpr-topbar { transform: none; pointer-events: auto; }
}
.bpr-topbar__actions { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; }
.bpr-topbar__share-wrap { position: relative; width: 40px; height: 40px; flex: 0 0 auto; }
.bpr-topbar__share { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; height: 40px; min-width: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: flex-end; padding: 0 11px; border-radius: 999px; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; font: 500 13px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .01em; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; background: rgba(255,255,255,.13); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(140%); backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(140%); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22); transition: background .22s ease, color .22s ease, border-color .22s ease, transform .18s ease; z-index: 3; }
.bpr-topbar__share svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; flex-shrink: 0; display: block; }
.bpr-topbar__share-label { max-width: 0; opacity: 0; margin-right: 0; overflow: hidden; }
.bpr-topbar__share:hover, .bpr-topbar__share:focus-visible { background: var(--ink); color: #fff; border-color: var(--ink); outline: none; z-index: 4; }
.bpr-topbar__share:active { transform: scale(.96); }
.bpr-topbar__cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--brand, #1a1714); color: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--brand, #1a1714); font: 600 13px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .01em; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background .22s ease, border-color .22s ease, gap .22s ease; }
.bpr-topbar__cta svg { width: 14px; height: 14px; flex-shrink: 0; }
.bpr-topbar__cta:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand, #1a1714) 84%, #000); border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--brand, #1a1714) 84%, #000); gap: 10px; }
body[data-scrolled] .bpr-topbar { background: #ffffff; -webkit-backdrop-filter: none; backdrop-filter: none; border-bottom-color: rgba(26,23,20,.16); }
body[data-scrolled] .bpr-topbar__mark-home, body[data-scrolled] .bpr-topbar__mark-vertical { color: var(--ink); }
body[data-scrolled] .bpr-topbar__mark-home:focus-visible, body[data-scrolled] .bpr-topbar__mark-vertical:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--ink); }
body[data-scrolled] .bpr-topbar__share { background: transparent; color: var(--ink); border-color: rgba(17,17,17,.16); }
body[data-scrolled] .bpr-topbar__share:hover { background: var(--ink); color: #fff; border-color: var(--ink); }
@media (min-width: 768px) {
  body:has(.bpr-hero--light) .bpr-topbar__back, body:has(.bpr-hero--light) .bpr-topbar__share, body:has(.bpr-hero--light) .bpr-topbar__ghar { background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #111); border-color: rgba(17,17,17,.16); }
  body:has(.bpr-hero--light) .bpr-topbar__back:hover, body:has(.bpr-hero--light) .bpr-topbar__share:hover, body:has(.bpr-hero--light) .bpr-topbar__ghar:hover { background: var(--ink, #111); color: #fff; border-color: var(--ink, #111); }
}
@media (max-width: 767px),
           (max-width: 1024px) and (orientation: portrait) {
  .bpr-topbar, .bpr-topbar__subnav { display: none; }
}
body:has(.bpr-hero--split) .bpr-topbar__mark-home, body:has(.bpr-hero--split) .bpr-topbar__mark-vertical, body:has(.bpr-hero--split) .bpr-topbar__share, body:has(.bpr-hero--split) .bpr-topbar__share-label { color: var(--ink-strong, #1a1714); }
body:has(.bpr-hero--split) .bpr-topbar__mark-vertical:hover, body:has(.bpr-hero--split) .bpr-topbar__share:hover { color: var(--brand); }
body:has(.bpr-hero--split) .bpr-topbar__mark-home:focus-visible, body:has(.bpr-hero--split) .bpr-topbar__mark-vertical:focus-visible { outline-color: var(--ink-strong, #1a1714); }
body:has(.bpr-hero--split)[data-scrolled] .bpr-topbar__share:hover { background: var(--brand-soft, rgba(198,126,53,.14)); color: var(--brand); border-color: transparent; }
body:has(.bpr-hero--split)[data-scrolled] .bpr-topbar__share:hover .bpr-topbar__share-label { color: var(--brand); }
body:has(.bpr-hero--split) .bpr-topbar__share { background: rgba(255,255,255,.85); border: 1px solid rgba(26,23,20,.08); backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(10px); }
body:has(.bpr-hero--split) .bpr-topbar__tabs a { color: var(--ink-strong); }
body:has(.bpr-hero--split) .bpr-topbar__tabs a:hover { color: var(--brand); }
body:has(.bpr-hero--split) .bpr-topbar__tabs a.is-active { background: var(--brand-soft, rgba(198,126,53,.14)); color: var(--brand); }
body:has(.bpr-hero--split) .bpr-topbar[data-scrolled] .bpr-topbar__tabs a.is-active { background: var(--brand); color: #fff; }
body:has(.bpr-hero--split) .bpr-topbar[data-scrolled] .bpr-topbar__tabs a:hover { background: var(--brand-soft, rgba(198,126,53,.14)); color: var(--brand); }
body:has(.bpr-hero--split) .bpr-topbar[data-scrolled] { background: rgba(250,247,242,.86); backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(12px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: saturate(1.4) blur(12px); border-bottom-color: rgba(26,23,20,.18); }
)(); </script> <!-- Scroll-past-hero flag + top-bar height sync. body[data-scrolled] swaps the top-bar from glass-over-hero to solid warm-white once the hero bottom passes the viewport top. --bpr-topbar-h feeds the sub-nav's sticky-top offset (so it parks flush under the bar) and the scroll-margin-top on section anchors (so #about, #work etc. land under the bar, not behind it). --> <script> (function () { var hero = document.querySelector('.bpr-hero'); var bar = document.querySelector('.bpr-topbar'); if (!hero || !bar) return; function syncH() { var h = bar.getBoundingClientRect().height; document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--bpr-topbar-h', h + 'px'); } var __dirLastY = window.scrollY; var __dirMainHidden = false; function onScroll() { var y = window.scrollY; var dy = y - __dirLastY; if (y > 40) document.body.setAttribute('data-scrolled', ''); else document.body.removeAttribute('data-scrolled'); var heroBottom = hero.getBoundingClientRect().bottom; var pastHero = heroBottom < 60; if (pastHero) { document.body.setAttribute('data-past-hero', ''); if (dy > 12) __dirMainHidden = true; else if (dy < -12) __dirMainHidden = false; if (__dirMainHidden) document.body.setAttribute('data-nav-hidden', ''); else document.body.removeAttribute('data-nav-hidden'); } else { document.body.removeAttribute('data-past-hero'); document.body.removeAttribute('data-nav-hidden'); __dirMainHidden = false; } var img = document.querySelector('.pp-portrait, .bpr-hero__bg, .bpr-hero__ambient'); if (img) { var pastImage = img.getBoundingClientRect().bottom < 20; if (pastImage) document.body.setAttribute('data-past-image', ''); else document.body.removeAttribute('data-past-image'); } if (Math.abs(dy) > 12) __dirLastY = y; } syncH(); window.addEventListener('resize', syncH, { passive: true }); window.addEventListener('scroll', onScroll, { passive: true }); onScroll(); }

Use it when

  • The top chrome of a brand profile, in place of the portal navbar, placed before main.bpr-page
  • Person profiles use the same bar (emitted by the generator with /people as the vertical link)

Avoid

  • The portal navbar partial on a profile, or a second sub-nav bar. The sub-nav was removed; this is the only bar
  • Adding per-tenant colour rules for the share button or G-mark. Photo-hero tenants are detected with :has(.bpr-hero__bg) and dark tenants with data-theme="dark"; both get the right ink automatically
  • Recolouring the Contact pill on a dark tenant with a page rule. The shared body:is(.pp-page, [data-brand-format])[data-theme="dark"] .bpr-topbar__cta rule wins even over !important and has painted dark text on a red pill before; fix the shared rule, not the page
  • Forking tenant-specific topbar CSS. Seven different inline copies already exist
  • Pasting it into a new tenant. Brand tenants start from _dev/templates/brand-profile-{family}.html via the brand-profile-work skill or /new-brand-profile; person pages come from npm run build:people

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.bpr-topbarclassFixed bar. Page CSS sets 84px at rest (--bpr-bar-rest) and 56px once scrolled; shared styles.min.css then re-pads it (measured 65px scrolled at 1280). Page CSS hides it at 767px and below and on portrait tablets, where the sticky contact bar takes over.
.bpr-topbar__mark-homeclassG-mark link home. Hidden on scroll in favour of .bpr-topbar__title. At tablet widths its colour switches white or dark by hero type.
.bpr-topbar__mark-verticalclassThe vertical link: Brands on brand profiles, People on person profiles.
.bpr-topbar__titleclassTenant name, shown in place of the G-mark on scroll.
.bpr-topbar__ctaclassContact pill in --brand. Revealed by CSS at body[data-scrolled]. Carries data-brand-contact.
.bpr-topbar__shareclassRound Share button with a label that expands on hover. Carries data-brand-share, which opens the profile share sheet. Dark glass with white ink over photo heroes, ink on light glass on service tenants, brand-filled after scroll.
.bpr-topbar__menumodifierCo-classed with .bpr-topbar__share. Opens the shared #ocMenu via openOC().
body[data-scrolled]attributeSet by the page scroll script. Gives the bar its white surface, swaps the mark for the title and reveals Contact.
body[data-brand-format]attributeProfile context most shared rules are scoped to, with body.pp-page for people.

Source _dev/reference/components/brand-profile-topbar.html

Person profile

Person profile contact card

Paste In shared CSS

The closing dark card of a /people profile: a Get in touch eyebrow, a two-line Work with / Person Name title, a short reassurance line, an optional list of direct contact links and a primary Get in touch button that opens the contact modal.

Needs/dist/styles.min.css
Where
Used on 14 pages

person-profile-adi-godrej.html person-profile-ashish-bajoria.html person-profile-darshini-mahadevia.html person-profile-devesh-motta.html person-profile-hardik-shah.html person-profile-hemal-shah.html person-profile-hiten-motta.html person-profile-manpreet-singh.html person-profile-pirojsha-godrej.html person-profile-satish-bhansali.html person-profile-suman-kanodia.html person-profile-tarun-motta.html person-profile-vinod-doshi.html person-profile-virendra-shah.html

Guidelines
Production gap: the generator always emits an empty ul[data-pp-contact-meta]. The script that fills it from .pp-reach links (populatePpContactMeta) exists only in person-profile-hemal-shah.html, hand-added and not in scripts/build-person-profiles.mjs, so the list is empty on the other 13 pages and would vanish from hemal-shah on the next build. The preview shows one row as that script would render it. .pp-contact__meta-icon is the only consumer of --contact-divider.
Preview 
<section class="pp-contact" id="contact" aria-labelledby="ppContactTitle">
  <div class="pp-contact__inner pp-rise">
    <div class="pp-contact__body">
      <p class="pp-contact__eye">Get in touch</p>
      <h2 class="pp-contact__title" id="ppContactTitle"><span class="pp-contact__title-lead">Work with</span><span class="pp-contact__title-name">Person Name</span></h2>
      <p class="pp-contact__lead">Send a note about a project, a commission, or a conversation worth recording. Nothing is published without your say.</p>
      <ul class="pp-contact__meta" data-pp-contact-meta aria-label="Direct contact"></ul>
    </div>
    <div class="pp-contact__cta">

        Get in touch
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M13 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

Use it when

  • The last section of every generated person profile, inside .pp-wrap and before the microfooter
  • It shares its card chassis with the brand contact card (see brand-profile-contact), but on body.pp-page a later shared rule repaints the card as a dark panel from --brand-ink and --brand with !important, so --contact-surface, --contact-ink and the border and shadow tokens have no effect here

Avoid

  • Hand-editing it on a person page or pasting it elsewhere. Person profiles are generated by npm run build:people from scripts/person-profile-data.mjs
  • A second Get in touch in the hero. This card and the sticky bar are the two places the action lives
  • Inventing email or phone rows to fill .pp-contact__meta. It only lists real reach links from the record

API

NameTypeWhat it does
#contactattributeKeep id="contact". Shared rules are scoped through it (the stacked title, meta rows) and the sticky bar stands down while it is in view.
.pp-contact__innerclassThe card, painted by the shared body :is(.pp-contact__inner, .bpr-contact__inner) rule with --contact-surface and the other card tokens.
.pp-contact__titleclassGazpacho title; on body.pp-page #contact it stacks .pp-contact__title-lead over .pp-contact__title-name (both unstyled spans).
.pp-contact__metaclassul[data-pp-contact-meta] of li > .pp-contact__meta-icon + a rows, meant to be filled from the hero reach links by a page script.
.pp-contact__ctaclassCTA panel reading the --contact-cta-panel-* tokens.
.pp-contact__cta-btnclassjm-btn jm-btn--primary button with data-brand-contact and data-brand; background from --contact-cta-bg.

Source _dev/reference/components/person-profile-contact.html

Person profile hero

Paste Inline CSS: paste it too

The opening of a /people profile: a portrait (or a monogram tile when no real portrait exists) beside the category badge, name, role, city, a short brief and the ways to reach them, closed by a full-width Specialises in fact bar.

Needs/dist/styles.min.css
Where
Used on 15 pages

person-profile-adi-godrej.html person-profile-ashish-bajoria.html person-profile-darshini-mahadevia.html person-profile-devesh-motta.html person-profile-hardik-shah.html person-profile-hemal-shah.html person-profile-hiten-motta.html person-profile-manpreet-singh.html person-profile-pirojsha-godrej.html person-profile-satish-bhansali.html person-profile-suman-kanodia.html person-profile-tarun-motta.html person-profile-vinod-doshi.html person-profile-virendra-shah.html person-profile.html

Guidelines
Status is inline: most pp-hero rules are in dist/styles.min.css, but the generator also writes about 5 KB of hero CSS into every page (the @style here, from person-profile-darshini-mahadevia.html), including .pp-hero__head, .pp-hero--tall and .pp-fb__spark, which exist nowhere else. The generator still emits a .bpr-hero__overlay block (glass Back and Share) at the top of the header, and its comment calls it a do-not-drop contract, but styles.min.css hides it on body.pp-page, so it is left out of this snippet. .pp-fb is this fact bar, not a feedback component. img-fade has no CSS anywhere; it is only a hook.

}

.pp-portrait-wrap { position:relative }
.pp-portrait-wrap { position:relative }

.pp-role a:hover { background-size:100% 2px }
.pp-actions { display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;margin-top:26px }

.pp-fb__spark { display:inline-flex;width:18px;height:18px;flex-shrink:0;color:var(--ink) }

.pp-fb__cell:not(:last-child)::after { content:'';flex:0 0 auto;align-self:center; width:1px;height:13px;background:rgba(26,23,20,.16) }
.pp-fb__t { margin:0;font:500 15px/1.5 'Inter',sans-serif;color:var(--ink) }
.pp-fb__t a { color:inherit;text-decoration:none; background-image:linear-gradient(var(--ink),var(--ink));background-size:0 1px; background-repeat:no-repeat;background-position:0 100%; transition:background-size .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) }

  .pp-fb__cell:last-child { padding-bottom:18px }
  .pp-fb__cell:not(:last-child)::after { display:none }
}

.pp-idfacts li { display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px }

@media(min-width:640px) {

@media(max-width:767px) {
  body.pp-page .pp-hero { padding-top:clamp(24px,5vw,30px) }

.pp-closer .pp-actions { justify-content:center;margin-top:24px }

Use it when

  • Sits first inside main.bpr-page > .pp-wrap, which supplies the page gutter and max width
  • Every generated person profile. The generator picks the portrait or monogram from the record and adds pp-hero--tall only when there is a brief and at least three facts to fill a full-height hero
  • Reference for what the generator emits, when reviewing a person page or adding a field to scripts/person-profile-data.mjs

Avoid

  • Hand-editing person-profile-*.html or pasting this into a page. Person profiles are generated by npm run build:people from scripts/person-profile-data.mjs; edit the data or the generator
  • Stock, AI or illustrated portraits. A real portrait or the monogram tile only
  • Putting a Get in touch button in the hero. The sticky bar and topbar carry it; .pp-actions holds only the quiet reach links
  • Forcing pp-hero--tall on a sparse record. A short record gets a short hero

API

NameTypeWhat it does
body.pp-pageattributePage context. The shared pp-* rules and the rise-in animation are scoped to it.
.pp-wrapclassPage container the generator wraps every section in (max-width var(--max-w), side padding var(--pad-h)). Defined only in the inline page CSS.
.pp-hero--tallclassFull-height hero on desktop (880px and up, 640 to 1100px tall), only for a record with a brief and three or more facts.
.pp-portraitclassPortrait frame. Add .pp-portrait--mono with a .pp-portrait__mono span of initials when there is no real portrait.
.pp-badge / .pp-name / .pp-roleclassCategory, the h1 and the role line (role links to the brand profile when one exists).
.pp-idfactsclassIcon plus text facts: city, experience, discipline.
.pp-briefclassShort paragraph under the head.
.pp-actionsclassReach links only (website, LinkedIn and so on); empty when the record has none.
.pp-fbclassFact bar closing the hero: .pp-fb__l label with the .pp-fb__spark glyph, then .pp-fb__cell items. Stacks under 880px.
.pp-riseclassStaggered rise-in on load (ghar-pp-rise keyframes in styles.min.css); --d sets the delay.

Directories

Brands directory card and grid

Paste Inline CSS: paste it too

The card every brand gets on /brands and on search result grids: a 16:9 brand photo with the logo tile overlapping its lower edge, an optional paid-tier badge, the brand name, locality, up to three category tags and a Contact button. Cards sit in a three, two, one column grid.

Needs/dist/styles.min.css
Where
Used on 2 pages

brands-search.html brands.html

Guidelines
Status is inline: .brand-card and .br-cat-grid exist in no shared stylesheet. brands.html carries one copy (about 6 KB) and brands-search, ghartalks-search and voices-search carry a second, identical among themselves but different from brands.html (media ground #f5efe4, an extra --focus badge variant, different badge padding). The CTA listener and the modal are page-inline on each page. Some live cards use a logo image as the photo with inline object-fit and padding styles because the brand has no photography.
Preview 
<section class="br-section" aria-label="Brands directory">

          Featured
        </span>

        <div class="brand-card__hdr">
          <div class="brand-card__meta">
            <h3 class="brand-card__name">Brand Name</h3>
          </div>
        </div>
        <span class="brand-card__loc">Locality &middot; City</span>
        <ul class="brand-card__tags"><li>Category</li><li>Category</li><li>Category</li></ul>
      </div>
      </a>
      <div class="brand-card__foot"><button type="button" class="brand-card__cta" data-brand="Brand Name">Contact Brand Name <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12h14M13 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
      </div>

  </div>
</section>
.br-section { max-width:var(--max-w); margin:0 auto; padding:clamp(48px, 5vw, 72px) clamp(24px, 4vw, 56px); }
.br-section + .br-section { padding-top:0 }
.br-cat-grid { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(3, 1fr); gap:24px; align-items:stretch; }
@media (max-width:1023.98px) {
  .br-cat-grid { grid-template-columns:repeat(2, 1fr); gap:20px }
}
@media (max-width:600px) {
  .br-cat-grid { grid-template-columns:1fr; gap:16px }
}
.brand-card { position:relative; display:flex; flex-direction:column; background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--rule); border-radius:16px; overflow:hidden; text-decoration:none; color:inherit; transition:transform .3s ease, box-shadow .3s ease, border-color .3s ease; clip-path:inset(0 round 16px); transform:translateZ(0); backface-visibility:hidden; -webkit-backface-visibility:hidden; }
.brand-card:hover { transform:translateY(-3px) translateZ(0); border-color:var(--ink); box-shadow:0 24px 56px -24px rgba(26,23,20,.28); }
.brand-card__media { position:relative; aspect-ratio:16/9; }
.brand-card__media > img { position:absolute; inset:0; width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; border-radius:16px 16px 0 0; transition: transform .6s ease; }
.brand-card:hover .brand-card__media img { transform:scale(1.04) }
.brand-card__media::before { content:''; position:absolute; top:12px; right:12px; width:40px; height:40px; border-radius:50%; background-color:#fff; background-image:url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='%23111' stroke-width='2.2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><path d='M7 17L17 7M8 7h9v9'/></svg>"); background-position:center; background-size:16px; background-repeat:no-repeat; opacity:0; transform:translate(6px,6px) scale(.55); transition:opacity .3s ease, transform .45s cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); z-index:2; box-shadow:0 12px 28px -10px rgba(0,0,0,.45); }
.brand-card:hover .brand-card__media::before { opacity:1; transform:translate(0,0) scale(1); }
.brand-card__badge { position:absolute; top:12px; left:12px; z-index:2; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:5px; padding:6px 11px; background:rgba(26,23,20,.85); color:#fff; border-radius:999px; font:700 9.5px/1 'Inter',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; backdrop-filter:blur(6px); }
.brand-card__badge--sponsored { background:#c48b2a; color:#fff }
.brand-card__badge--featured, .brand-card__badge--spotlight { background:#faf5eb; color:#eda41c; padding:4px 12px 4px 4px; border-radius:8px; backdrop-filter:none; }
.brand-card__badge--featured svg, .brand-card__badge--spotlight svg { width:22px; height:22px; padding:5px; border-radius:6px; background:#eda41c; color:#fff; box-sizing:border-box; }
.brand-card__badge--signature, .brand-card__badge--partner { background:#1a1714; color:#fff; padding:4px 12px 4px 4px; border-radius:8px; backdrop-filter:none; }
.brand-card__badge--signature svg, .brand-card__badge--partner svg { width:22px; height:22px; padding:5px; border-radius:6px; background:#d5613a; color:#fff; box-sizing:border-box; }
.brand-card__badge svg { width:11px; height:11px; flex-shrink:0 }
.brand-card__body { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:12px; padding:60px 20px 22px; flex:1; }
.brand-card__logo { position:absolute; left:50%; bottom:0; transform:translate(-50%, 50%); z-index:3; min-height:92px; min-width:140px; max-width:270px; padding:16px 30px; background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--rule); border-radius:18px; box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(26,23,20,.08), 0 12px 32px -12px rgba(26,23,20,.2); display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; }
.brand-card__logo img { transition: transform .6s ease; max-height:56px; max-width:210px; width:auto; height:auto; object-fit:contain; display:block; }
.brand-card__logo--dark { background:#1a1714; border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.18); }
.brand-card__logo-mono { font:700 26px/1 'Gazpacho', Georgia, serif; color:var(--muted); letter-spacing:-.005em; white-space:nowrap; }
.brand-card__hdr { display:block; min-width:0; text-align:center }
.brand-card__meta { display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:3px; align-items:center }
.brand-card__name { font:700 19px/1.2 'Gazpacho', Georgia, serif; color:var(--ink); margin:0; max-width:100%; white-space:nowrap; overflow:hidden; text-overflow:ellipsis; }
.brand-card__loc { display:flex; align-items:baseline; justify-content:center; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:2px 6px; font:500 12.5px/1.3 'Inter', sans-serif; color:var(--ink); }
.brand-card__tags { display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; gap:6px; padding:4px 0 0; margin:0; list-style:none; }
.brand-card__tags li { font:600 12.5px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; padding:7px 12px; background:#f6f4f0; border:1px solid #e8e5df; border-radius:6px; color:#4a4139; white-space:nowrap; }
.brand-card__link { color:inherit; text-decoration:none; display:flex; flex-direction:column; flex:1; }
.brand-card__link:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset:-2px; border-radius:inherit }
.brand-card__foot { padding:0 20px 22px; }
.brand-card__cta { width:100% }
.brand-card__cta { position:relative; z-index:2; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; margin-top:4px; padding:12px 18px; border:1px solid var(--rule); border-radius:999px; color:var(--ink); background:transparent; font:600 12.5px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; font-family:'Inter',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.02em; text-decoration:none; cursor:pointer; transition:background .22s ease, color .22s ease, border-color .22s ease, gap .22s ease; }
.brand-card__cta:hover { background:var(--ink); color:#fff; border-color:var(--ink); gap:10px; }
.brand-card__cta svg { width:12px; height:12px; flex-shrink:0 }
.brand-card__logo { pointer-events:none }
.brand-card__logo img { pointer-events:none }
.br-cat-grid > .is-hidden { display:none }
.brand-card.is-revealing { animation: brandCardReveal .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1) both; }
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .brand-card.is-revealing { animation:none }
}
@keyframes brandCardReveal { from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(10px)} to {opacity:1; transform:none} }

Use it when

  • The /brands directory grid, and the brand result grids on brands-search, ghartalks-search and voices-search
  • Logo tile holds the real logo image; when the brand has no usable logo file, .brand-card__logo-mono sets the brand name as a type tile instead
  • The Featured badge only for a brand that has bought the Brand Connect Featured or Signature package (the badge text names the tier)

Avoid

  • A badge on an unpaid listing, or any tier word other than Featured or Signature
  • Tinting the logo tile with the brand colour. White tile, real logo
  • Wrapping the Contact button inside the card link. It sits in .brand-card__foot so it is its own target
  • A per-page card fork. brands.html and the three search pages already carry two diverging copies of this CSS

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.br-sectionclassDirectory section wrapper (max-width var(--max-w), directory padding).
.br-cat-gridclassThree columns, two under the tablet breakpoint, one on phones. Direct children with .is-hidden are removed from the grid by the progressive reveal.
.brand-card[data-cat]attributeCard, carrying the taxonomy parent slug the category filter reads.
.brand-card__linkclassWraps media and body, links to /brands/{slug}.
.brand-card__mediaclass16:9 photo box; the photo img fills it.
.brand-card__logo / .brand-card__logo-monoclassWhite logo tile over the media edge; the mono span is the no-logo fallback.
.brand-card__badge--featuredclassPaid-tier badge, star glyph plus Featured or Signature.
.brand-card__name / __loc / __tagsclassName (h3), locality line and up to three tags.
.brand-card__ctaclassContact button. A delegated listener on the page opens the directory contact modal for data-brand.
.is-revealingclassAdded briefly by window.gharGridReveal as batched rows appear; runs the brandCardReveal rise.

Directory search empty state

Paste Inline CSS: paste it too

What people and brands search show when the filters leave nothing: a No matches eyebrow, a plain one-line title, a short suggestion and two actions, share a project brief or reset the filters.

Needs/dist/styles.min.css
Where
Used on 4 pages

brands-search.html ghartalks-search.html people-search.html voices-search.html

Guidelines
Status is inline: the CSS is copied into both search pages' style blocks (see directory-results-toolbar for the drift). The copy is page-specific: people-search says Nobody here matches that yet and brands-search words it for brands.
Preview 
<section class="brs-empty" id="brsEmpty" hidden aria-live="polite">
  <p class="brs-empty__eyebrow">No matches</p>
  <h2 class="brs-empty__title">Nobody here matches that yet.</h2>
  <p class="brs-empty__dek">Try widening the filters, or tell us what you&rsquo;re building and we&rsquo;ll go find the right person for your project.</p>
  <div class="brs-empty__ctas">
    <a href="/people/brief" data-brief-open data-brief-source="people-search" class="btn-primary">
      Share your project brief
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M13 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg>
    </a>
    <button type="button" class="btn-secondary" id="brsEmptyReset">Reset filters</button>
  </div>
</section>
.brs-empty { max-width:820px; margin:clamp(48px,6vw,80px) auto 0; padding:clamp(40px,5vw,64px) clamp(24px,4vw,48px); text-align:center; background:#faf7f2; border:1px solid var(--rule); border-radius:16px; }
.brs-empty__eyebrow { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; font:700 10.5px/1 'Inter',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); margin:0 0 18px; }
.brs-empty__eyebrow::before, .brs-empty__eyebrow::after { content:""; width:20px; height:1px; background:var(--rule) }
.brs-empty__title { font:700 clamp(24px,3vw,34px)/1.15 'Gazpacho',Georgia,serif; color:var(--ink); margin:0 0 12px; }
.brs-empty__dek { font:400 15px/1.6 'Inter',sans-serif; color:var(--muted); margin:0 auto 28px; max-width:52ch; }
.brs-empty__ctas { display:inline-flex; flex-wrap:wrap; justify-content:center; gap:12px; }
.brs-empty__ctas .btn-primary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:14px 24px; background:var(--ink); color:#fff; border:1px solid var(--ink); border-radius:999px; font:600 13px/1 'Inter',sans-serif; letter-spacing:.02em; text-decoration:none; transition:gap .22s ease; }
.brs-empty__ctas .btn-primary:hover { gap:12px }
.brs-empty__ctas .btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:6px; padding:12px 22px; background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--rule); border-radius:999px; font:600 13px/1 'Inter',sans-serif; color:var(--ink); cursor:pointer; transition:border-color .22s ease; }
.brs-empty__ctas .btn-secondary:hover { border-color:var(--ink) }

Use it when

  • people-search.html and brands-search.html, after the results grid, shown by the filter script when the visible count hits zero
  • The primary action opens the brief flow (data-brief-open with a data-brief-source naming the page); the secondary resets every filter

Avoid

  • Illustrations or a mascot. It is a quiet type-only block
  • Dropping the reset button. It is the only one-tap way out of an over-filtered state
  • Pointing the brief CTA at a form page without data-brief-open, which would skip the brief modal

API

NameTypeWhat it does
#brsEmpty[hidden]attributeSection id the filter script toggles; aria-live=polite announces it.
.brs-empty__eyebrowclassNo matches label with hairlines either side.
[data-brief-open][data-brief-source]attributeOpens the brief modal and records which page sent the visitor.
#brsEmptyResetattributeReset filters button the page script listens to.

Directory search results toolbar

Paste Inline CSS: paste it too

The bar above a people or brands search grid: the searched terms restated as the page H1, a live result count and a custom Sort dropdown (Featured, A to Z, Newest).

Needs/dist/styles.min.css
Where
Used on 4 pages

brands-search.html ghartalks-search.html people-search.html voices-search.html

Guidelines
Status is inline: no brs-* rule is in a shared stylesheet. people-search.html and brands-search.html each carry a copy of the toolbar and empty-state CSS (about 4 KB) and they differ, most visibly the .brs-toolbar__title rules that only people-search has. The sort script in @js is page-inline on both pages and does not reorder anything (its own comment marks it a programmer handoff). The preview shows the H1 unhidden with a sample query and the panel open.
Preview 
<section class="brs-toolbar" aria-label="Results toolbar">
  <h1 class="brs-toolbar__title" data-result-title hidden></h1>
  <div class="brs-toolbar__count" aria-live="polite">
    <strong id="brsCount">31</strong> people
  </div>

.brs-toolbar__title { font-family:var(--ff-display,'Gazpacho',Georgia,serif); font-weight:700; font-size:clamp(26px,3.2vw,40px); line-height:1.05; letter-spacing:-0.02em; color:var(--ink); margin:0; flex:1 1 100%; }
.brs-toolbar { align-items:baseline }
.brs-toolbar { max-width:1280px; margin:0 auto; padding:clamp(20px,2.2vw,28px) clamp(24px,4vw,56px) clamp(4px,0.6vw,8px); display:flex; flex-wrap:wrap; gap:12px 20px; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; }
.brs-toolbar__count { font:400 14px/1.4 'Inter',sans-serif; color:var(--muted); }
.brs-toolbar__count strong { font-weight:700; color:var(--ink); margin-right:3px; }
.brs-sort { position:relative; display:inline-flex; align-items:center }
.brs-sort__trigger { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; padding:10px 14px 10px 16px; background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--rule); border-radius:999px; font:600 13px/1 'Inter',sans-serif; color:var(--ink); cursor:pointer; transition:border-color .18s ease; }
.brs-sort__trigger:hover, .brs-sort__trigger[aria-expanded="true"] { border-color:var(--ink) }
.brs-sort__prefix { color:var(--muted); font-weight:500; margin-right:2px }
.brs-sort__chev { width:11px; height:11px; flex-shrink:0; transition:transform .2s ease }
.brs-sort__trigger[aria-expanded="true"] .brs-sort__chev { transform:rotate(180deg) }
.brs-sort__panel { position:absolute; top:calc(100% + 6px); right:0; min-width:200px; background:#fff; border:1px solid var(--rule); border-radius:12px; box-shadow:0 12px 32px -12px rgba(20,17,15,.2), 0 2px 6px rgba(20,17,15,.05); padding:6px; opacity:0; pointer-events:none; transform:translateY(-4px); transition:opacity .18s ease, transform .18s ease; z-index:50; }
.brs-sort__panel[data-open] { opacity:1; pointer-events:auto; transform:translateY(0) }
.brs-sort__opt { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; width:100%; padding:10px 12px; background:transparent; border:0; border-radius:8px; font:500 13.5px/1 'Inter',sans-serif; color:var(--muted); cursor:pointer; text-align:left; transition:background .18s ease, color .18s ease; }
.brs-sort__opt:hover { background:#f6f4f0; color:var(--ink) }
.brs-sort__opt[aria-selected="true"] { color:var(--ink); font-weight:600 }
.brs-sort__opt-check { width:14px; height:14px; opacity:0; flex-shrink:0 }
.brs-sort__opt[aria-selected="true"] .brs-sort__opt-check { opacity:1 }
@media (max-width:768px) {
  .brs-toolbar { gap:12px }
}
(function(){
  var btn   = document.getElementById('brsSortBtn');
  var panel = document.getElementById('brsSortPanel');
  var label = document.getElementById('brsSortLabel');
  var wrap  = document.getElementById('brsSort');
  if (!btn || !panel || !label) return;
  function open(){
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    panel.setAttribute('data-open', '');
  }
  function close(){
    btn.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
    panel.removeAttribute('data-open');
  }
  btn.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    e.stopPropagation();
    if (btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true') close();
    else open();
  });
  panel.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    var opt = e.target.closest('.brs-sort__opt');
    if (!opt) return;
    e.stopPropagation();
    [].forEach.call(panel.querySelectorAll('.brs-sort__opt'), function(o){
      o.setAttribute('aria-selected', o === opt ? 'true' : 'false');
    });
    var text = (opt.childNodes[0] && opt.childNodes[0].textContent || '').trim();
    label.textContent = text;
    close();
  });
  document.addEventListener('click', function(e){
    if (!wrap.contains(e.target)) close();
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
    if (e.key === 'Escape' && btn.getAttribute('aria-expanded') === 'true') close();
  });
})();

Use it when

  • people-search.html and brands-search.html, directly above .br-section.brs-results
  • The H1 restates only what the visitor searched (a quoted name, a discipline, a city, or discipline in city) and stays hidden when nothing is searched. It is the result-title pattern: no breadcrumb above it
  • The count updates with the filters; keep aria-live on it

Avoid

  • A manufactured heading for the unfiltered state, such as People across India. No search, no H1
  • A breadcrumb or a category hero above the results
  • A native select for Sort. The custom trigger and panel keep the portal dropdown look
  • Treating Sort as working. The click only changes the label today; re-sorting is a programmer handoff

API

NameTypeWhat it does
[data-result-title]attributeThe H1 the filter script fills and unhides. Present on people-search only; brands-search has no result title.
.brs-toolbar__countclassLive count; the number sits in strong#brsCount.
#brsSort / #brsSortBtn / #brsSortPanel / #brsSortLabelattributeIds the sort script reads. aria-expanded on the trigger and data-open on the panel carry the open state.
.brs-sort__opt[aria-selected]attributeOption; the selected one shows .brs-sort__opt-check. data-value is featured, az or new.

Source _dev/reference/components/directory-results-toolbar.html

People directory card and grid

Paste Inline CSS: paste it too

The card each person gets on /people and on people search: a 4:3 real portrait (or a Gazpacho monogram tile while a portrait is being sourced), an optional inherited paid-tier badge, name with a claimed-profile tick, role, city, expertise tags and a Connect button, in a three, two, one column grid.

Needs/dist/styles.min.css
Where
Used on 2 pages

people-search.html people.html

Guidelines
Status is inline: people.html and people-search.html do not load dist/brand-profile.min.css and each carries its own full copy of the .bpr-person card CSS (about 6.5 KB, and the two copies differ). So the same card class is painted by three sources that can drift: dist/brand-profile.min.css on brand tenants, and the two directory page style blocks. The @style is the people.html copy. The monogram class is live here (19 cards on /people) while brand tenant team rails use inline styles instead.

.pe-page .bpr-person { --brand: var(--ink); --brand-soft: #f0ebe0; }
.bpr-person { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 22px; padding: 12px; overflow: hidden; transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), box-shadow .35s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1), border-color .3s ease; }

.bpr-person:hover .bpr-person__media img { transform: scale(1.05); }
.bpr-person__badge { position: absolute; top: 12px; left: 12px; z-index: 2; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 5px; padding: 4px 12px 4px 4px; border-radius: 8px; font: 700 9.5px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; }

.bpr-person__verified svg { width: 100%; height: 100%; display: block; }

.bpr-person__link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ink); outline-offset: -2px; border-radius: inherit; }
.bpr-person__foot { padding: 0 8px 6px; }
.bpr-person__cta { position: relative; z-index: 2; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; width: 100%; padding: 11px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--ink); background: transparent; font: 600 12.5px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .01em; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background .22s ease, color .22s ease, border-color .22s ease, gap .22s ease; }
.bpr-person__cta:hover { background: var(--ink); color: #fff; border-color: var(--ink); gap: 10px; }

.pe-cat-grid > .is-hidden { display:none }
.bpr-person.is-filtered-out { display:none }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .bpr-person.is-revealing { animation:none }

@keyframes peCardReveal { from{opacity:0; transform:translateY(10px)} to {opacity:1; transform:none} }

Use it when

  • The /people directory grid and the people-search result grid
  • Portrait when a real photograph of the person exists; monogram tile (.bpr-person__media--mono) only as a stand-in while the portrait is sourced
  • The badge only when the person is a named founder of a brand on a paid Brand Connect tier (the co-founder inheritance rule)
  • The verified tick only for a claimed profile maintained by the person

Avoid

  • Stock, AI or illustrated faces. Real portrait or monogram only
  • Listing a person with neither: add is-no-portrait, which removes the card from the grid
  • A badge on someone with no paid brand behind them
  • Wrapping Connect inside the card link

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.pe-section / .pe-cat-gridclassDirectory section and grid: three columns, two under 1024px, one under 600px.
.bpr-person[data-cat][data-city]attributeCard, with the discipline slug and city the filters read (city through window.gharCityMatch).
.pe-page .bpr-personclassOn the directory the card resets --brand to var(--ink) and --brand-soft to #f0ebe0, so monograms are ink on warm grey, not a tenant colour. Put pe-page on the page wrapper.
.bpr-person__media--mono / .bpr-person__monoclassMonogram stand-in: --brand-soft ground, Gazpacho initials in --brand, no hover scrim.
.bpr-person__badge--featured / --signatureclassInherited paid-tier badge over the portrait.
.bpr-person__verifiedclassCheck-circle tick inside the name for a claimed profile.
.bpr-person__ctaclassConnect button; data-brand-contact opens the contact modal for data-brand.
.is-no-portrait / .is-filtered-out / .is-hiddenclassRemoval states: no portrait and no monogram, filtered out, and not yet revealed (grid child).

Use it when

  • The last block on a pillar, collection, Voices or GharTalks landing, after the newsletter
  • Scoping the pitch to the vertical in copy and in the ?vertical= parameter

Avoid

  • Opening a contact form from it. Section CTAs are navigation; it links to /brand-connect
  • A second sponsor pitch mid-page (Sponsor a season). Same pitch, same audience, shown twice
  • A sponsor attribution on it. This is our sales close, not a paid placement

API

.dp-partnerclassThe single anchor, a grid: icon, content, CTA.
.dp-partner__iconslotLine icon in a disc. aria-hidden.

.dp-spread, .dp-strip, .dp-showcase, .dp-findarch, .dp-river{max-width:var(--max-w); margin:0 auto; padding:clamp(48px, 5vw, 72px) var(--pad-h);}
.nr-card{display:flex; flex-direction:column; text-decoration:none; color:inherit}
.nr-card__thumb{aspect-ratio:16/10; overflow:hidden; background:#eee; border-radius:var(--r,16px)}
.nr-card__thumb img{width:100%; height:100%; object-fit:cover; transition:transform .7s ease}
.nr-card:hover .nr-card__thumb img{transform:scale(1.04)}
.nr-card__body{display:flex; flex-direction:column; gap:10px; padding:16px 0 0; flex:1}
.nr-card__eyebrow{font:700 10px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing:.14em; text-transform:uppercase; color:var(--muted); margin:0; display:block;}
.nr-card__title{font-family:'Gazpacho', Georgia, serif; font-weight:700; font-size:clamp(18px, 1.5vw, 24px); line-height:1.22; letter-spacing:0; color:var(--ink); margin:0; display:-webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp:2; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; overflow:hidden;}
.nr-card__dek{font:400 13.5px/1.6 'Inter', sans-serif; color:var(--muted); margin:0; display:-webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp:3; -webkit-box-orient:vertical; overflow:hidden;}
@media (min-width: 1080px){
  .grid-3col-editorial__col:not(.grid-3col-editorial__col--center) .nr-card__thumb{aspect-ratio:1/1}
  .grid-3col-editorial__col--center .nr-card__thumb{aspect-ratio:16/9}
  .grid-3col-editorial__col:not(.grid-3col-editorial__col--center) .nr-card__body{padding:14px 0 0; gap:8px}
  .grid-3col-editorial__col:not(.grid-3col-editorial__col--center) .nr-card__title{font-size:clamp(17px,1.3vw,20px)}
  .grid-3col-editorial__col:not(.grid-3col-editorial__col--center) .nr-card__dek{font-size:13px; line-height:1.55}
  .grid-3col-editorial__col--center .nr-card__body{padding:18px 0 0; gap:12px}
  .grid-3col-editorial__col--center .nr-card__title{font-size:clamp(22px,1.8vw,30px)}
  .grid-3col-editorial__col--center .nr-card__dek{font-size:15px; line-height:1.65}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  .nr-card, .nr-card__thumb img{transition:none !important; transform:none !important}
}
@media (min-width: 744px) and (max-width: 1079.98px){
  .dp-spread .grid-3col-editorial{grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; grid-template-areas: none; column-gap: 24px; row-gap: 40px;}
  .dp-spread .grid-3col-editorial__col{display: contents;}
  .dp-spread .grid-3col-editorial__col--center{grid-area: auto;}
}

Use it when

  • Slot 2 on a Subject pillar: the long-reads and defining pieces an editor pins
  • Any landing that needs six featured stories above the fold without six identical cards

Avoid

  • Feeding it the latest six. That is the job of the sub-topic strips; the spread is editorial voice on a slow cadence
  • Repeating a spread story in a strip below. Exclude spread story ids from every strip at query time (pillar de-duplication rule)
  • Directory pillars. Series and Designers lead with their directory rail instead

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.dp-spreadclassSection wrapper with the shared pillar spacing.
.grid-3col-editorialclassShared three-column grid from styles.css. Two cards per column.
.grid-3col-editorial__col--centermodifierThe prominent middle column. At 744 to 1079px the columns dissolve into a two-up grid.
.nr-cardclassThe card: thumb, eyebrow, Gazpacho title, three-line dek. Its CSS is inline on the page, not in styles.css.

Source _dev/reference/components/design-pillar-spread.html

.dp-findarch{max-width:var(--max-w); margin:0 auto; padding:clamp(48px, 5vw, 72px) var(--pad-h);}

.dp-findarch__cta:hover{transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 14px 28px -16px rgba(26,23,20,.32)}

@media(max-width:899px){

Use it when

  • Mid-page on a Subject pillar, where the reader might move from reading to hiring (Find an architect)
  • A single lead-generation door that must not look like an ad

Avoid

  • A form inside the card or a pop-up. It is one link to the brief page
  • A sponsor credit on it. The reader is doing something, and functional surfaces are never sponsored
  • Two of them on one page, or placing it before the first editorial items

NameTypeWhat it does

.dp-findarch__mediaslotrole="img" with aria-label, photo via background-image. Stacks above the body under tablet width.

Where

design-architecture.html design-heritage.html design-series.html ghartalks-category.html ghartalks.html voices-perspectives.html voices.html

Preview 
<aside class="dp-adslot" aria-label="Sponsored, Brand name">
  <a href="/brands/brand-slug" class="dp-adslot__inner" style="--brand-canvas: #0a3d62; --brand-text: #ffffff;">
    <div class="dp-adslot__media" style="background-image:url('https://placehold.co/1600x1000/0a3d62/9fb6c8?text=Campaign+image')">
      <span class="dp-adslot__badge">Sponsored</span>
    </div>
    <div class="dp-adslot__body">
      <div class="dp-adslot__content">
        <span class="dp-adslot__brand">Brand name</span>
        <h2 class="dp-adslot__title">A headline of about thirty characters or a little more.</h2>
        <p class="dp-adslot__lead">One short lead line, around forty characters, supplied by the brand.</p>
      </div>
      <span class="dp-adslot__cta">
        Explore
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M13 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg>
      </span>
    </div>
  </a>
</aside>

Use it when

  • Rate-card inventory at the foot of an editorial stream, or between strips once three editorial items have run
  • Inside a .dp-river__list as an in-stream unit, wrapped in li.dp-river-ad
  • Any vertical reusing the pillar chassis (Voices, GharTalks) that sells a billboard

Avoid

  • The first viewport or above the stream. Paid punctuates, it never gates
  • Two billboards, or a billboard next to a sponsored card. Put editorial between them
  • Bright or pale panel colours. Use a deep muted brand tone; the CTA is a white pill, so a light canvas makes it vanish
  • An image whose right edge is in a different colour family from --brand-canvas. The fade shows a hard seam
  • Inventing the brand hex. Take it from the brand's own record, and do not repeat an advertiser already placed on another pillar

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.dp-adslotclassThe <aside>. aria-label names the sponsor: "Sponsored, Brand".
.dp-adslot__innerclassThe single anchor. Hover lifts 2px, adds shadow and widens the CTA gap.
--brand-canvastokenPanel colour and the colour the image fades into. Set inline per instance.
--brand-texttokenPanel text colour, normally #ffffff.
.dp-adslot__badgeslotThe Sponsored label over the image. Never remove it.
.dp-river-adclassWrap the aside in <li class="dp-river-ad"> to sit inside a .dp-river__list.

Source _dev/reference/components/design-pillar-adslot.html

Where
Used on 3 pages

design-architecture.html ghartalks-category.html ghartalks.html

Guidelines
Inline family, and the copies have diverged. design-architecture.html (source here) is the non-sticky in-page filter rebuilt 2026-08-14. design-heritage.html, voices.html, voices-conversations.html, voices-perspectives.html, voices-quotes.html, voices-speakers.html, ghartalks.html and ghartalks-category.html still carry the older position:sticky version with a body.mainnav-hidden offset.

<nav class="dp-filterstrip" aria-label="Filter Pillar name">
  <div class="dp-filterstrip__inner">
    <a href="/design/pillar" class="dp-chip is-active" aria-current="page">All</a>
    <a href="/design/pillar?tag=topic-one" class="dp-chip">Topic one</a>
    <a href="/design/pillar?tag=topic-two" class="dp-chip">Topic two</a>
    <a href="/design/pillar?tag=topic-three" class="dp-chip">Topic three</a>

.dp-filterstrip{background:var(--warm-white, #faf7f2); border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule); padding-block:0;}
.dp-filterstrip__inner{max-width:var(--max-w); margin:0 auto; padding:16px var(--pad-h); display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; overflow-x:auto; scrollbar-width:none; -webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;}
.dp-filterstrip__inner::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.dp-chip{display:inline-flex; align-items:center; padding:8px 16px; border:1px solid var(--rule); border-radius:999px; background:#fff; color:var(--ink); font:500 13px/1.1 'Inter', sans-serif; text-decoration:none; white-space:nowrap; flex-shrink:0; cursor:pointer; transition:background .18s ease, border-color .18s ease, color .18s ease;}
.dp-chip:hover{border-color:var(--ink)}
.dp-chip.is-active{background:var(--ink); color:#fff; border-color:var(--ink)}
.dp-chip__count{margin-left:6px; font-size:11px; color:var(--muted); font-weight:400}
.dp-chip.is-active .dp-chip__count{color:rgba(255,255,255,.7)}
@media (max-width:600px){
  .dp-filterstrip__inner{padding:12px clamp(20px, 4vw, 56px); gap:6px}
  .dp-chip{padding:7px 14px; font-size:12px}
}

Use it when

  • Slot 2 on a Subject pillar (Architecture, Interiors, Spaces, Vastu, Guides) broad enough to have several tags
  • The active-filter return path on a GharTalks beat page

Avoid

  • Directory pillars (Series, Designers). The directory items already are the sub-topics, so chips would repeat the names below
  • Collection pages. There is nothing left to filter
  • Making it sticky or turning chips into underlined tabs. Tabs read as navigation, and a second active tab pointing at the same URL as the L2 bar is the bug this replaced
  • A sponsor attribution on the strip. Filters are utility

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.dp-filterstripclassFull-width band on warm white with a bottom hairline. Cancels the shared main > section padding.
.dp-chipclassOne pill link. Tag views are ?tag= filters on the pillar URL.
.is-activemodifierInk-filled chip for the current view. Pair with aria-current="page".
.dp-chip__countslotOptional muted count inside a chip.

Source _dev/reference/components/design-pillar-filter-strip.html

The type-only opening of a /design pillar or collection landing: one Gazpacho title and a one-line dek. No image, so the page name reads the same at any length and nothing competes with the stream below.

Needs/dist/styles.min.css/design-listing.css
Where
Used on 8 pages

design-architecture.html design-heritage.html design-series.html ghartalks-category.html voices-conversations.html voices-perspectives.html voices-quotes.html voices-speakers.html

Guidelines
Inline family. The .dp-* chassis is copied into the <style> block of ten pages: design-architecture.html (canonical, copied from here), design-heritage.html, design-series.html, voices.html, voices-conversations.html, voices-perspectives.html, voices-quotes.html, voices-speakers.html, ghartalks.html and ghartalks-category.html. The hero rules are byte-identical across all ten.

<section class="dp-hero" aria-labelledby="dpHeroTitle">
  <div class="dp-hero__head">
    <h1 id="dpHeroTitle" class="dp-hero__title">Pillar name</h1>
  </div>

.dp-hero{max-width: var(--max-w); margin: 0 auto; padding: clamp(40px, 5vw, 72px) var(--pad-h) clamp(28px, 3vw, 40px);}
.dp-hero__crumbs{display:flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font:500 12px/1 'Inter',sans-serif; color:var(--muted); letter-spacing:.02em; margin:0 0 clamp(20px,2.4vw,32px);}
.dp-hero__crumbs a{color:var(--muted);text-decoration:none;transition:color .18s ease}
.dp-hero__crumbs a:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.dp-hero__crumbs svg{width:12px;height:12px;flex-shrink:0;opacity:.55}
.dp-hero__crumbs .dp-hero__crumbs-current{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.dp-hero__head{margin: 0;}
.dp-hero__title{font-family: var(--ff-display, 'Gazpacho', Georgia, serif); font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(40px, 7.5vw, 88px); line-height: 0.96; letter-spacing: -0.025em; color: var(--ink); margin: 0;}
.dp-hero__dek{max-width: 720px; margin: clamp(20px,2vw,28px) 0 0; font:400 clamp(15px,1.2vw,17px)/1.6 'Inter',sans-serif; color: var(--muted);}
@media (max-width: 600px){
  .dp-hero{padding-top: 28px; padding-bottom: 20px;}
  .dp-hero__dek{font-size:14px; line-height:1.65; margin-top:16px;}
}

Use it when

  • Act 1 of every /design/{pillar} and collection landing (Architecture, Heritage, Series)
  • The top of a Voices or GharTalks sub-page that needs a plain title and dek before its stream

Avoid

  • Adding breadcrumbs back. They were removed because the logo, the subnav label and this title already say all three levels
  • Explaining the editorial system in the dek (what a series or franchise is). One reader-first line: count, format, subject
  • A sponsored card or billboard straight after it. The editorial stream must lead the first viewport

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.dp-heroclassSection wrapper. Carries --max-w and --pad-h itself, so it sits directly in <main>.
.dp-hero__titleclassThe H1. Gazpacho 700, clamp(40px, 7.5vw, 88px).
.dp-hero__dekclassOne line of reader-first copy, max 720px.
.dp-hero__crumbsclassStill styled but unused on shipped pages. Leave it out.

(function init(){
  if (typeof window.initCarousel !== 'function') { setTimeout(init, 50); return; }
  var rail = document.getElementById('dpQuotesRail');
  var outer = document.getElementById('dpQuotesOuter');
  if (!rail || !outer) return;
  rail.style.width = 'max-content';
  rail.style.flexWrap = 'nowrap';
  window.initCarousel({
    outer: outer,
    track: rail,
    prevBtn: document.getElementById('dpQuotesPrev'),
    nextBtn: document.getElementById('dpQuotesNext'),
    snap: 'page',
    widthMode: 'fractional-n',
    cssVarHost: outer,
    nVar: '--n',
  });
})();

Use it when

  • A Subject pillar mid-page, linking readers to the full Voices interview behind each line
  • Short attributed lines that each have a real piece to read

Avoid

  • Directory pillars. The pull-quote spread was cut from Series because it does not help a reader pick a show
  • Quotes without a piece behind them. A quote is a card until it earns a page, and every slide links somewhere real
  • Placeholder quotes on real named people going live. Replace them with sourced lines first

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.dp-quotes-outer.rail-outerclassCarousel viewport on the shared rail chassis. Its --n is 1, so each slide fills it.
.dp-quotes-rail.railclassThe track, a <ul role="list">.
.dp-quotes-cardclassWhole slide is one anchor: mark, quote, author, .btn-link cue as a span.
.dc-paginatorclassShared prev/next buttons, centred under the slide.
initCarousel(opts)JSsnap:'page', widthMode:'fractional-n', nVar:'--n' on the outer.

(function(){
  function wireSeries(){
    var rail = document.querySelector('.dp-series__rail');
    if (!rail) return;
    var outer = rail.closest('.rail-outer');
    if (!outer || rail.__chassisWired) return;
    rail.__chassisWired = true;
    rail.style.width = 'max-content';
    rail.style.flexWrap = 'nowrap';
    (function callInit(){
      if (typeof window.initCarousel !== 'function') { setTimeout(callInit, 50); return; }
      window.initCarousel({ outer: outer, track: rail, snap: 'free' });
    })();
  }
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', wireSeries);
  else wireSeries();
})();

Use it when

  • Related series at the foot of a Subject pillar (Series in Architecture)
  • Any short set of named franchises that link to their own /design/series/{slug} microsite

Avoid

  • Bespoke marks or stock photos on the posters. The media is the franchise's latest episode hero, so it refreshes itself
  • A Presented by tag on a poster. Per-card sponsor tags were removed from directory posters
  • Forking a second rail script. It is initCarousel on .rail-outer/.rail like every rail in the portal

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.dp-seriesclassSection with a top hairline, head (title + text link) and the rail.
.rail-outer / .rail.dp-series__railclassShared carousel chassis. Bleeds to the viewport edge on mobile.
.dp-series-cardclassPoster card: 4:5 media, Gazpacho name, muted count.
initCarousel(opts)JSCalled with snap:'free' on the rail's outer.

(function(){
  if (typeof gsap === 'undefined' || typeof ScrollTrigger === 'undefined') return;
  if (window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;

  gsap.registerPlugin(ScrollTrigger);

  var els = document.querySelectorAll('.el-scroll');
  if (!els.length) return;
  els.forEach(function(el){
    var stage = el.querySelector('.el-stage');
    var panel = el.querySelector('.el-stage__panel');
    if (!stage || !panel) return;

    gsap.set(panel, { opacity: 0, y: 24, xPercent: -50, yPercent: -50 });
    gsap.set(stage, { scale: 0.88, transformOrigin: 'center center' });

    var tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });
    tl.fromTo(stage, { scale: 0.88 }, { scale: 1, ease: 'none', duration: 1 }, 0);
    tl.to(panel, { opacity: 1, y: 0, ease: 'power2.out', duration: 0.55 }, 0.45);

    var proxy = { p: 0 };
    var maxP = 0;
    ScrollTrigger.create({
      trigger: stage,
      start: 'top 88%',
      end: 'top 28%',
      invalidateOnRefresh: true,
      onUpdate: function(self){
        var p = self.progress;
        if (p > maxP) {
          maxP = p;
          gsap.to(proxy, {
            p: p, duration: 0.5, ease: 'power1.out', overwrite: true,
            onUpdate: function(){ tl.progress(proxy.p); }
          });
        }
      },
      onLeave: function(self){
        tl.progress(1);
        self.kill();
      }
    });
  });

  if (document.fonts && document.fonts.ready) {
    document.fonts.ready.then(function(){ ScrollTrigger.refresh(); });
  }
})();

Use it when

  • Any sponsored, partnered or collaboration story on a /design landing. The moment a slot becomes sponsored it moves into this scene
  • Disclosure copy: In Collaboration With BRAND for an editorial collab, Presented By BRAND for paid promotion

Avoid

  • Editorial-only stories. They use the plain lead card; a disclosure strip on a standard card reads half-committed
  • A hover state on the brand name. Brand marks in the collab line are identity anchors
  • The first viewport, or next to another paid unit
  • Scrubbing filter, box-shadow or radius in the timeline. Transform and opacity only

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.el-scrollclassThe scene wrapper the script loops over. Adding a scene is markup only.
.el-stageclassThe image box that scales. 21:9, 16:10 at tablet, 4:5 on phones.
--el-imagetokenPer-instance background image, set inline on .el-stage__image.
.el-stage__panelclassThe link. A SIBLING of the stage, never a child, so the text is not scaled and stays crisp.
.el-stage__collab-brandslotThe brand name inside the disclosure line.

Use it when

  • A paid project placement dropped between strips, mid-stream on a Subject pillar
  • A featured story that is genuinely sponsored, where the disclosure must travel with the card

Avoid

  • The first viewport, or directly under the hero. No paid surface gates the editorial stream
  • Stacking it next to a native billboard. One paid unit at a time, with editorial between
  • Directory pillars (Series). A mid-scroll sponsored showcase was cut there as ad-block
  • Unsponsored stories. An editorial-only lead uses the plain card without the strip

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.dp-showcaseclassSection wrapper. Forces the lead card to 21:9 (max 560px), 4:3 under 744px with the dek hidden.
.hr-card--leadmodifierOverlay card: full-bleed media, bottom gradient, white type.
.hr-card__sponsored-stripslotTop disclosure: label left, Sponsored by <strong>Brand</strong> right.
.hr-card__eyebrow--paidmodifierWarm sand eyebrow that marks paid content without spending the brand red.

(function initDpRiverLoadMore(){
  var INITIAL = 3, BATCH = 3;
  var list = document.getElementById('dpRiverList');
  var wrap = document.getElementById('dpLoadMore');
  var btn = document.getElementById('dpLoadMoreBtn');
  if (!list || !wrap || !btn) return;

  var items = Array.prototype.slice.call(list.querySelectorAll('.dp-river-item'));
  if (!items.length) { wrap.classList.add('is-done'); list.classList.add('is-wired'); return; }

  for (var i = INITIAL; i < items.length; i++){
    var li = items[i].parentElement;
    (li || items[i]).classList.add('is-hidden');
  }
  list.classList.add('is-wired');
  var shown = Math.min(INITIAL, items.length);
  if (shown >= items.length) { wrap.classList.add('is-done'); return; }

  btn.addEventListener('click', function(){
    var end = Math.min(shown + BATCH, items.length);
    for (var j = shown; j < end; j++){
      var li = items[j].parentElement;
      (li || items[j]).classList.remove('is-hidden');
    }
    shown = end;
    if (shown >= items.length){
      wrap.classList.add('is-done');
    }
  });
})();

Use it when

  • The archive stream at the foot of a Subject pillar (More in Architecture)
  • The main stream of a collection landing, with one in-stream sponsored row around position four and a billboard at the foot

Avoid

  • Faux pagination. One Load more button, which hides itself when the list is exhausted
  • Leading the stream with the sponsored row or the billboard. At least three editorial rows first
  • A Sponsored pill on a row that is not paid. The pill and --paid eyebrow mean money changed hands
  • Directory pillars. An archive river was cut from Series because it duplicates the latest strips

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.dp-river__listclassThe <ul>. Give it an id for the load-more script.
.dp-river-itemclassOne row, a whole-row anchor inside each <li>. Stacks with a 16:9 thumb under 600px.
.dp-river-item--sponsoredmodifierAdds room for .dp-river-item__sponsor-pill on the thumb; pair with .dp-river-item__eyebrow--paid (Presented by Brand).
.dp-loadmore / .dp-loadmore__btnclassCentred outline button. The script adds .is-done when every row is visible.
.is-hiddenmodifierSet on the <li> by the script for rows past the current batch.

Use it when

  • Sub-topic or franchise sections on a pillar landing (Vernacular, Coastal, Studio Visit)
  • Any three-story row under a titled head that links out to the full tag view

Avoid

  • Showing a story already in the spread or featured slot above. Strips skip those ids and pull the next three by date
  • A sponsor line on the strip head. Sponsorship is per card; a section-level credit is only for a whole paid takeover
  • A fourth card or a second CTA. One section, three items, one see-all

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.dp-stripclassSection wrapper with the shared pillar spacing.
.dp-strip__headclassTitle left, button right. Below 744px it becomes display:contents so the button drops under the cards.
.dp-strip__linkclassRides on the shared .btn .btn-primary.
.ep-trioclassThree-column grid. Below 900px it turns into a bleed-edge horizontal scroller with snap.
.hr-card--edmodifierEditorial card: 4:3 thumb on top, eyebrow, Gazpacho title, byline below. The media zooms, the anchor never moves.

Industry Voices

Contribute doors

(function init(){
  if (typeof window.initCarousel !== 'function') { setTimeout(init, 50); return; }
  var rail  = document.getElementById('vxQuotesRail');
  var outer = document.getElementById('vxQuotesOuter');
  if (!rail || !outer) return;
  window.initCarousel({
    outer: outer,
    track: rail,
    snap: 'free',
    prevBtn: document.getElementById('vxQuotesPrev'),
    nextBtn: document.getElementById('vxQuotesNext')
  });
})();

Use it when

  • Curated quotes said somewhere else (a call, a post, a panel), with a live source
  • All three are required on every card: the verbatim sentence, .vx-quote__why framing and .vx-source
  • The rail on the landing; a plain grid (.vx-grid) on the quotes type page and in browse

Avoid

  • Any media on the card. We do not own imagery of that person in that moment
  • Dropping the framing line or the source. Without them it is a social wall, not intelligence
  • Giving a captured quote its own URL before it has editorial framing and a response piece attached
  • Writing a new rail script. The rail is .rail-outer/.rail plus initCarousel

API

NameTypeWhat it does
initCarouselfunctioninitCarousel({outer, track, snap:'free', prevBtn, nextBtn}) from /ghar-carousel.js. Needs the gsap global.
.vx-quote__whyslotOne sentence of editorial framing. Never optional.
.vx-sourceclassThe receipt: label, platform and date, outbound link. Inside a whole-card anchor the link is a span, not a nested <a>.
.dc-paginator / .dc-page-btnclassShared rail arrows, wired by id.

            <p class="vx-hero__claim">A short verbatim claim from the featured piece goes here.</p>
          </a>
        </blockquote>

          <img class="vx-speaker__face" src="https://placehold.co/128x128/e5dcc8/6e655b?text=Face" alt="Speaker name" width="64" height="64" loading="eager" decoding="async">
          <span class="vx-speaker__id">

          </span>

      <div class="vx-hero__foot">
