          <span class="vx-source__label">Source</span>
          <span class="vx-source__detail">Where it was said &middot; DD/MM/YYYY</span>
        </div>
        <a href="/voices/piece-slug" class="btn-link btn-link--underline">
          Read the conversation
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M13 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg>
        </a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
(function(){
  var q = document.querySelector('.vx-hero__claim');
  if (!q) return;
  var n = q.textContent.trim().length;
  var tier = n <= 80 ? 's' : n <= 140 ? 'm' : n <= 210 ? 'l' : 'xl';
  q.closest('.vx-hero__bubble').setAttribute('data-len', tier);
  if (n > 170 && window.console) {
    console.warn('[voices] Hero quote is ' + n + ' characters, over the 170 cap. '
      + 'Pick a tighter pull quote or trim at a sentence boundary. '
      + 'See docs/VOICES-HANDOFF.md');
  }
})();

Use it when

  • The top of the /voices landing, one per page
  • Keep .vx-hero__intro as the page (static per vertical, the SEO surface) and .vx-hero__card as the featured piece (rotates)
  • Set data-len on the blockquote server-side (s up to 80 characters, m 140, l 210, xl beyond); the inline script recomputes it as a fallback

Avoid

  • Letting the featured piece's copy bleed into the intro, or the page reads as described by whatever story is featured
  • Truncating the quote. No line-clamp, no ellipsis; pick a tighter pull quote past 170 characters
  • A solid button in the foot. The quote box is already the mass, so the read link is .btn-link--underline
  • Labelling the kicker This week if the featured piece will not rotate weekly. Use Featured

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.vx-hero__introslotThe page: h1.vx-hero__title and p.vx-hero__desc. Static.
.vx-hero__cardslotThe featured piece: kicker, stage, foot. Below 744px the card and stage drop their box and lay out on the body.
data-lenattributes | m | l | xl on .vx-hero__bubble. Selects the quote size tier.
.vx-speaker--lgmodifierThe 64px speaker size used in the hero stage.

  <p class="gtk-empty__title">Nothing here yet</p>
  <p class="gtk-empty__body">One sentence that explains the empty result and offers a way out.</p>
</div>

Use it when

  • Every listing of episodes: beat pages, search, related episodes, and the landing rail
  • Order is fixed: still, beat eyebrow, title, guest credit, meta
  • .gtk-mono in the credit slot when the guest is an organisation, which has no face
  • .gtk-card--lead on the first card of a grid to span the row horizontally at 1080px and up
  • .gtk-empty when a beat and tag combination has no episodes: a sentence with a way out

Avoid

  • A text CTA or a second link on the card. One destination per card; the play glyph is an affordance, not an action
  • A hover transform on the anchor. The lift is on .gtk-card__media
  • gtk-mono as a portrait fallback for a named person. A person without a real portrait gets a text-only credit
  • Format pills or format eyebrows. Every item is a conversation; the eyebrow is the beat

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.gtk-gridclassThe episode grid on beat and search pages.
.gtk-card--leadmodifierFirst card spans the row and goes horizontal at 1080px and up.
.gtk-facade__durslotDuration chip, mm:ss. Leave it out rather than guess a figure.
.gtk-monoslotCompany initial inside .vx-speaker--sm, before .vx-speaker__id.
.gtk-emptyclassN=0 block with .gtk-empty__title and .gtk-empty__body. Toggle with hidden.
data-beat / data-guest / data-tagsattributeFilter keys read by the beat and search page scripts.

Source _dev/reference/components/ghartalks-card.html

(function init(){
  if (typeof window.initCarousel !== 'function') { setTimeout(init, 50); return; }

  [['gtkLatest', 'gtkLatestNav'], ['gtkGuests', 'gtkGuestsNav']].forEach(function (pair) {
    var id = pair[0];
    var outer = document.getElementById(id + 'Outer');
    var track = document.getElementById(id + 'Track');
    var nav   = document.getElementById(pair[1]);
    if (!outer || !track) return;

    window.initCarousel({
      outer: outer,
      track: track,
      prevBtn: document.getElementById(id + 'Prev'),
      nextBtn: document.getElementById(id + 'Next')
    });

    function syncNav(){
      if (!nav) return;
      var kids = track.children;
      if (!kids.length) { nav.hidden = true; return; }
      var span  = kids[kids.length - 1].getBoundingClientRect().right
                - kids[0].getBoundingClientRect().left;
      var avail = outer.clientWidth
                - parseFloat(getComputedStyle(track).paddingLeft)
                - parseFloat(getComputedStyle(track).paddingRight);
      nav.hidden = span <= avail + 2;
    }
    syncNav();
    window.addEventListener('resize', syncNav, { passive: true });
    window.addEventListener('load', syncNav, { once: true });
  });
})();

Use it when

  • Latest conversations and The guests on the /ghartalks landing
  • Guest cards (.gtk-guest, 3:4 portrait, name, role) link to /people/{slug} and need a real portrait
  • Init with initCarousel and re-check the arrows on resize and load

Avoid

  • Arrows on a rail that cannot scroll. syncNav hides the nav when the content fits
  • Organisations in the guest rail. They have no face; they appear only as .gtk-mono credits on cards
  • A page-local carousel. The rail is .rail-outer/.rail plus initCarousel with .gtk-rail for shadow clearance

API

NameTypeWhat it does
initCarouselfunctioninitCarousel({outer, track, prevBtn, nextBtn}) from /ghar-carousel.js. Needs the gsap global.
.gtk-strip__headclassTitle block (.gtk-strip__title, .gtk-strip__dek) and .gtk-strip__nav.
{id}Outer / {id}Track / {id}Prev / {id}NextidId convention the init loop reads; the nav id is passed alongside.
.gtk-guestclassPortrait card: .gtk-guest__media (img), .gtk-guest__name, .gtk-guest__role.

Source _dev/reference/components/ghartalks-rail.html

.art-body sup a:hover, .art-fn-ref:hover{color: var(--accent, #ee324b);}
.art-footnotes{margin: 56px 0 0; padding: 28px 0 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8);}
.art-footnotes__head{font: 600 11px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); margin: 0 0 18px;}
.art-footnotes ol{font-size: 13.5px; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--ink2, #374151); padding-left: 24px; margin: 0;}
.art-footnotes li{margin-bottom: 12px; padding-left: 4px; border-radius: 4px; transition: background-color .25s ease, padding .25s ease; scroll-margin-top: calc(var(--mainnav-h, 80px) + var(--subnav-h, 56px) + 24px);}
.art-footnotes li:last-child{margin-bottom: 0;}
.art-footnotes li:target{background-color: rgba(212, 159, 64, 0.22); padding: 10px 12px 10px 8px;}
.art-footnotes a{color: var(--ink, #111);}
.art-body h2[id], .art-body h3[id], .art-body sup[id], .art-body [id]{scroll-margin-top: calc(var(--mainnav-h, 80px) + var(--subnav-h, 56px) + 24px);}
.art-body p.has-dropcap::first-letter, .art-lead.has-dropcap::first-letter{float: left; font-family: 'Gazpacho', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 76px; line-height: 0.86; padding: 6px 12px 0 0; color: var(--ink, #111);}
@media (max-width: 600px){
  .art-body p.has-dropcap::first-letter, .art-lead.has-dropcap::first-letter{font-size: 58px; padding: 4px 10px 0 0;}
}

Use it when

  • Every story body: .art-body-wrap > .art-body holds all blocks in reading order
  • One .art-lead.has-dropcap to open; h2 for sections (the TOC is built from them), h3 inside a section
  • .art-specs for a project fact list right after the lead on a design story
  • .art-pullquote for a short line lifted from the story; .art-pullquote--byline when the speaker's face and role belong with it; .art-blockquote for a long quotation with a full citation
  • Wrap inline images in a.pswp-link with data-pswp-width and data-pswp-height so the lightbox can open them

Avoid

  • Red on quote marks, list markers or rules
  • A pull quote that is not in the story text
  • Portrait images without --portrait. The modifier keeps them from filling the column height

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.art-lead.has-dropcapmodifierOpening paragraph with a Gazpacho drop cap.
.art-inline-image--wide / --portraitmodifierBreaks wider than the column; portrait constrains a tall image.
.pswp-linkclassLightbox trigger inside a [data-pswp-gallery] figure. The PhotoSwipe module is wired inline on each article page (see photo-lightbox).
.art-pullquote--bylinemodifierAdds .art-pullquote__head with avatar, name and role above the quote.
.art-footnotesclassNotes list; refs in the text are <sup id=fn-ref-n><a href=#fn-n>.

Article hero and byline

Paste Inline CSS: paste it too

The top of a story page: a thin reading-progress bar, then eyebrow, Gazpacho title, deck and the byline (avatar and author link, updated tag with a link to the editor's note, date, read time), then a full-width hero figure with caption and credit.

Needs/dist/styles.min.css/design-listing.css
Where
Used on 3 pages

design-article.html ghartalks-article.html voices-article.html

Guidelines
Inline family. Source here is design-article.html. voices-article.html and ghartalks-article.html carry byte-identical hero, eyebrow, title, deck and progress rules, but their .art-byline copy has diverged: it adds a max-width 700.98px rule that wraps the byline and puts the author on its own line. The progress and TOC scripts are inline on each article page.
Preview 
<div class="art-progress" aria-hidden="true">

</div>

<main class="art-page" id="main">

.art-page{padding-bottom: 0;}
.art-hero{max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; padding: clamp(36px, 4.5vw, 64px) clamp(24px, 4vw, 56px) clamp(32px, 4vw, 56px);}
.art-hero__head{max-width: 920px; margin: 0 auto; text-align: center;}
.art-eyebrow{display: inline-block; font: 600 10px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--faint, #6e655b); margin: 0 0 20px;}
.art-title{font-family: 'Gazpacho', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(30px, 3.8vw, 48px); line-height: 1.1; letter-spacing: -.015em; color: var(--ink, #111); margin: 0 auto 0; max-width: 22ch;}
.art-deck{max-width: 56ch; margin: 24px auto 0; font: 400 19px/1.55 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--ink2, #374151); text-align: center;}
@media (max-width: 600px){
  .art-hero__head{text-align: left;}
  .art-title{font-size: clamp(24px, 6.5vw, 28px); max-width: none; margin-left: 0;}
  .art-deck{font-size: 15.5px; line-height: 1.5; text-align: left; margin: 18px 0 0; max-width: none;}
  .art-hero__head .art-byline{margin-top: 22px; align-items: flex-start;}
  .art-hero__head .art-byline__date-wrap{justify-content: flex-start;}
  .art-hero__head .art-byline__updated-link{font-size: 11.5px;}
}
.art-byline{max-width: 820px; margin: clamp(28px, 3.5vw, 40px) auto 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 400 13px/1.4 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #6e655b);}
.art-byline__sep{display: none;}
@media (min-width: 701px){
  .art-byline{flex-direction: row; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px;}
  .art-byline__sep{display: inline;}
}
.art-byline__author{display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: var(--ink, #111); text-decoration: none; transition: opacity .2s ease;}
.art-byline__author:hover{opacity: .75;}
.art-byline__avatar{width: 32px; height: 32px; border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; background: var(--rule, #e8e8e8);}
.art-byline__name{font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #111); font-size: 13.5px;}
.art-byline__sep{color: var(--muted, #6e655b); margin: 0 2px; user-select: none;}
.art-byline__time, .art-byline__date{white-space: nowrap;}
.art-byline__date-wrap{display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: center;}
.art-byline__updated-tag{font: 700 9px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink, #111); padding: 4px 7px; background: rgba(212, 159, 64, 0.22); border-radius: 3px;}
.art-byline__updated-link{font: 400 12px/1.4 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-thickness: 1px; text-underline-offset: 3px; transition: color .18s ease;}
.art-byline__updated-link:hover{color: var(--ink, #111);}
.art-hero-figure{margin: clamp(32px, 4vw, 48px) 0 0;}
.art-hero-figure img{display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--rule, #e8e8e8);}
.art-hero-figure figcaption{max-width: 920px; margin: 14px auto 0; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; font: 400 12px/1.5 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #6e655b);}
.art-hero-figure__credit{font-style: italic;}
.art-progress{position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0; height: 2px; background: transparent; pointer-events: none; z-index: 1;}
.art-progress__fill{height: 100%; width: 0; background: var(--accent, #ee324b); transform-origin: left center; transition: width .08s linear;}
@media print{
  .art-progress{display: none;}
}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
  .art-progress__fill{transition: none;}
}
(function(){
  var fill = document.getElementById('artProgressFill');
  if (!fill) return;
  var body = document.querySelector('.art-body');
  var endZone = document.querySelector('.art-tags-wrap') || document.querySelector('.art-credits');
  if (!body) return;
  var ticking = false;
  function tick(){
    var bodyTop = body.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY;
    var endTop = endZone
      ? endZone.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY
      : (body.getBoundingClientRect().bottom + window.scrollY);
    var span = Math.max(1, endTop - bodyTop);
    var passed = Math.min(span, Math.max(0, (window.scrollY + window.innerHeight * 0.6) - bodyTop));
    var pct = Math.round((passed / span) * 1000) / 10;
    fill.style.width = pct + '%';
    ticking = false;
  }
  window.addEventListener('scroll', function(){
    if (!ticking){ requestAnimationFrame(tick); ticking = true; }
  }, { passive: true });
  window.addEventListener('resize', tick, { passive: true });
  tick();
})();

Use it when

  • Every /design, /voices and /ghartalks story page, once, as the <header> of the <article>
  • Eyebrow names the series or subject; deck is one or two sentences
  • Show the Updated tag and see editor's note link only when a correction note exists in the body
  • The progress bar is bound to .art-body and stops at the tags, not at the page foot

Avoid

  • Naming the subject in the byline on a Conversation. The byline is the journalist; the subject goes in .art-speaker-strip (see article-qa)
  • A hero figure on a GharTalks episode. The episode page swaps .art-hero-figure for the video hero (see video-facade)
  • Truncating the title. Length gets width, not smaller type

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.art-progress / #artProgressFillclassFixed progress bar; the script sets the fill width from scroll position through .art-body.
.art-hero__headslot.art-eyebrow, h1.art-title, .art-deck, .art-byline.
.art-byline__updated-tag / __updated-linkslotOnly when the story carries a correction; the link targets the note id.
.art-hero-figureclassHero image with figcaption and .art-hero-figure__credit.

Editor's notes and methodology

Paste Inline CSS: paste it too

Trust blocks inside a story body: the editor's note (default), its disclosure, warning and correction variants, each a left rule with a label, and the methodology and sources panel as a definition list.

Needs/dist/styles.min.css/design-listing.css
Where
Used on 3 pages

design-article.html ghartalks-article.html voices-article.html

Guidelines
Inline family. Byte-identical copies in design-article.html (source here), voices-article.html and ghartalks-article.html. ghartalks-article.html ships the --disclosure note live.
Preview 
<aside class="art-note" id="correction">
  <span class="art-note__label">Editor&rsquo;s note</span>
  <p>The note text.</p>
</aside>

<aside class="art-note art-note--disclosure">
  <span class="art-note__label">Disclosure</span>
  <p>What the partner funded, and what editorial kept control of.</p>
</aside>

  <span class="art-note__label">Before you go</span>

</aside>

<aside class="art-note art-note--correction">
  <span class="art-note__label">Correction</span>
  <p>What an earlier version said, and what is correct.</p>
</aside>

<aside class="art-methodology" aria-label="Methodology">
  <span class="art-methodology__label">Methodology &amp; sources</span>
  <dl class="art-methodology__list">
    <div><dt>Reporting</dt><dd>How the reporting was done.</dd></div>
    <div><dt>Data</dt><dd>Where the figures come from.</dd></div>
    <div><dt>Last refreshed</dt><dd><time datetime="2026-01-01">1 January 2026</time></dd></div>
  </dl>
</aside>
.art-note{margin: 40px 0; padding: 22px 26px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8); border-left: 3px solid var(--ink, #111); border-radius: 6px; background: #fff;}
.art-note__label{display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 600 10px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); margin: 0 0 10px;}
.art-note__label::before{content: ''; width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink, #111); flex-shrink: 0;}
.art-note p{font: 400 14.5px/1.65 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--ink2, #374151); margin: 0 0 10px;}
.art-note p:last-child{margin-bottom: 0;}
.art-note--disclosure{border-left-color: #d49f40; background: #fdfaf2;}
.art-note--disclosure .art-note__label{color: #8a6d2a;}
.art-note--disclosure .art-note__label::before{background: #d49f40;}
.art-note--warning{border-left-color: #f37e86; background: #fff7f7;}
.art-note--warning .art-note__label{color: #c3464d;}
.art-note--warning .art-note__label::before{background: #f37e86;}
.art-note--correction{border-left-color: #4b5a8b; background: #f7f8fc;}
.art-note--correction .art-note__label{color: #4b5a8b;}
.art-note--correction .art-note__label::before{background: #4b5a8b;}
.art-methodology{margin: 40px 0; padding: 24px 0; border-top: 2px solid var(--ink, #111); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8);}
.art-methodology__label{display: block; font: 700 10px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink, #111); margin: 0 0 18px;}
.art-methodology__list{display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; column-gap: 32px; row-gap: 18px; margin: 0; padding: 0;}
.art-methodology__list > div{min-width: 0;}
.art-methodology__list dt{font: 600 10px/1.2 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); margin: 0 0 6px;}
.art-methodology__list dd{font: 500 14px/1.5 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #111); margin: 0;}
@media (max-width: 600px){
  .art-methodology__list{grid-template-columns: 1fr; row-gap: 14px;}
}

Use it when

  • .art-note for an editor's aside; give it id=correction when the byline links to it
  • .art-note--disclosure on every sponsored story, saying what the sponsor did and did not control, and on GharTalks episodes to say how the write-up was drafted
  • .art-note--warning for safety or access information the reader needs before acting
  • .art-note--correction for a post-publish correction, paired with the Updated tag in the byline
  • .art-methodology on data-driven and investigative stories

Avoid

  • Removing the disclosure note from a sponsored or machine-drafted story
  • Using --warning for emphasis. It is for risk

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.art-note--disclosure / --warning / --correctionmodifierSwap the left rule and label colour for the note's purpose.
.art-note__labelslotShort label above the note text.
.art-methodology__listclass<dl> of <div><dt><dd></div> rows.

.art-brand-callout{display: grid; grid-template-columns: 56px 1fr auto; gap: 16px; align-items: center; margin: 48px 0; padding: 20px 24px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8); border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color .2s ease, transform .2s ease;}

.art-brand-callout__label{font: 600 10px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); display: block; margin-bottom: 6px;}

.art-brand-callout__sub{font: 400 13px/1.5 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #6e655b);}
.art-brand-callout__arrow{color: var(--ink, #111); transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);}
.art-brand-callout:hover .art-brand-callout__arrow{transform: translateX(3px);}
.brl-item .art-tldr, .brl-item .art-takeaways, .brl-item .art-note, .brl-item .art-methodology, .brl-item .art-map, .brl-item .art-stat, .brl-item .art-qa, .brl-item .art-compare, .brl-item .art-audio, .brl-item .art-slot, .brl-item .art-brand-callout, .brl-item .art-rawhtml-details, .brl-item details{margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0;}
.art-speaker-strip{margin-top: 30px; max-width: calc(820px - 2 * clamp(24px, 4vw, 56px)); margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;}
.art-speaker-strip__face{border-radius: 50%; object-fit: cover; object-position: 50% 20%; padding: 0; background: var(--rule);}
@media (min-width: 744px){
  .art-speaker-strip{margin-top: 34px;}
}
@media (max-width: 600px){
  .art-speaker-strip{padding: 16px 18px; gap: 14px;}
  .art-speaker-strip .art-brand-callout__label{margin-bottom: 4px;}
  .art-speaker-strip .art-brand-callout__name{font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.25; margin-bottom: 2px;}
  .art-speaker-strip .art-brand-callout__sub{display: block; font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.35;}
  .art-speaker-strip .art-brand-callout__body{line-height: 1.35;}
  .art-speaker-strip .art-brand-callout__sep{display: none;}
  .art-speaker-strip .art-brand-callout__loc{display: block;}
}

Use it when

  • In this story (a brand), About the architect (a person), The project, and Read next, each linking to that page
  • .art-speaker-strip on a Voices or GharTalks Conversation, inside .art-hero after the byline, with a real portrait in the logo slot
  • Split the location into .art-brand-callout__sep and __loc so it wraps cleanly on a phone

Avoid

  • A speaker strip on a Perspective. The speaker wrote it, so the byline already names them
  • A face that is not a real portrait. Use the initials tile or leave the person out
  • A hover state on a brand wordmark inside the tile

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.art-brand-callout__logoslotInitials tile (a div) or, with .art-speaker-strip__face, a portrait <img>.
.art-brand-callout__label / __name / __subslotLabel, entity name, one sub line.

      <div class="pl-brand__fact">
        <span class="pl-brand__fact-label">Categories</span>
        <p class="pl-brand__fact-value">Category &middot; Category</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pl-brand__fact">
        <span class="pl-brand__fact-label">On this project</span>
        <p class="pl-brand__fact-value">What the brand supplied</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <a href="/brands/brand-slug" class="pl-brand__cta">
      Explore Brand name
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M13 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg>
    </a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="art-slot" data-slot-type="ad_display" data-slot-id="in-article-1" data-slot-size="standard" data-slot-audience="logged_out">
  <div class="pl-ad">
    <span class="pl-ad__label">Advertisement</span>
    <a href="/advertiser-destination" class="pl-ad__card">
      <div class="pl-ad__media">
        <img src="https://placehold.co/600x450/e5dcc8/6e655b?text=Ad" alt="Describe the ad image">
      </div>
      <div>
        <p class="pl-ad__brand">Advertiser name</p>
        <p class="pl-ad__headline">The advertiser's headline.</p>
        <span class="pl-ad__cta">Call to action</span>

      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M13 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg>
    </a>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="art-slot" data-slot-type="newsletter_signup" data-slot-id="mid-newsletter" data-slot-size="boxed" data-slot-audience="logged_out">
  <div class="pl-news">
    <p class="pl-news__eyebrow">Stay with the conversation</p>
    <h3 class="pl-news__title">One line on what the newsletter sends.</h3>
    <form class="pl-news__form" onsubmit="event.preventDefault()">
      <input type="email" placeholder="your@email.com" aria-label="Email address">
      <button type="submit">Subscribe</button>

.art-slot{margin: 40px 0;}
.art-slot:empty{padding: 28px 24px; border: 1.5px dashed var(--rule, #e8e8e8); border-radius: 10px; background: rgba(0, 0, 0, .02); text-align: center; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); font: 600 10px/1.4 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase;}
.art-slot:empty::before{content: 'Placement · ' attr(data-slot-type) ' · ' attr(data-slot-id); display: block;}
.art-slot:empty::after{content: 'Server fills this at render time'; display: block; margin-top: 8px; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: .04em; text-transform: none; font-size: 12px; color: var(--muted, #6e655b);}
.pl-brand{padding: 26px 28px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8); border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; display: grid; gap: 20px;}
.pl-brand__head{display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px;}
.pl-brand__logo{width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--ink, #111); color: #fff; font: 700 22px/1 'Gazpacho', Georgia, serif; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-shrink: 0;}
.pl-brand__eyebrow{display: block; font: 700 10px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); margin-bottom: 6px;}
.pl-brand .pl-brand__name{font: 700 24px/1.1 'Gazpacho', Georgia, serif; color: var(--ink, #111); margin: 0; letter-spacing: -.008em; max-width: none;}
.pl-brand__about{font: 400 14.5px/1.6 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--ink2, #374151); margin: 0;}
.pl-brand__facts{display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 20px; padding-top: 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8);}
.pl-brand__fact{min-width: 0;}
.pl-brand__fact-label{display: block; font: 700 9.5px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); margin: 0 0 7px;}
.pl-brand__fact-value{font: 500 13px/1.45 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #111); margin: 0;}
.pl-brand__cta{display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; justify-self: start; padding: 11px 20px; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #111); border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink, #111); text-decoration: none; font: 600 13px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; transition: background .18s ease, color .18s ease, gap .18s ease;}
.pl-brand__cta:hover{background: var(--ink, #111); color: #fff; gap: 12px;}
.pl-brand__cta svg{width: 14px; height: 14px;}
@media (max-width: 600px){
  .pl-brand{padding: 22px 20px; gap: 16px;}
  .pl-brand__logo{width: 48px; height: 48px; font-size: 19px;}
  .pl-brand__name{font-size: 21px;}
  .pl-brand__about{font-size: 14px;}
  .pl-brand__facts{grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 14px; padding-top: 14px;}
}
.pl-ad{border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8); padding: 18px 0;}
.pl-ad__label{display: block; font: 700 9.5px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); margin-bottom: 14px;}
.pl-ad__card{display: grid; grid-template-columns: 140px 1fr auto; gap: 18px; align-items: center; text-decoration: none; transition: transform .18s ease;}
.pl-ad__card:hover{transform: translateY(-1px);}
.pl-ad__media{aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--rule, #e8e8e8);}
.pl-ad__media img{width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block;}
.pl-ad__brand{font: 700 10px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); margin: 0 0 6px;}
.pl-ad__headline{font: 600 16px/1.35 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #111); margin: 0 0 8px; letter-spacing: -.005em;}
.pl-ad__cta{font: 600 12.5px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #111); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;}
.pl-ad__arrow{flex-shrink: 0; color: var(--ink, #111); transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1);}
.pl-ad__card:hover .pl-ad__arrow{transform: translateX(3px);}
@media (max-width: 600px){
  .pl-ad__card{grid-template-columns: 100px 1fr;}
  .pl-ad__arrow{display: none;}
  .pl-ad__headline{font-size: 14.5px;}
}
.pl-news{padding: 36px 32px; border-radius: 12px; background: var(--ink, #111); color: #fff; text-align: left; position: relative; overflow: hidden;}
.pl-news::before{content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: radial-gradient(circle at 92% 12%, rgba(212, 159, 64, 0.18) 0, transparent 42%), radial-gradient(circle at 6% 88%, rgba(212, 159, 64, 0.10) 0, transparent 38%); pointer-events: none;}
.pl-news > *{position: relative;}
.pl-news__eyebrow{display: block; font: 700 10px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .22em; text-transform: uppercase; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .65); margin: 0 0 14px;}
.pl-news .pl-news__title{font: 700 26px/1.18 'Gazpacho', Georgia, serif; color: #fff; margin: 0 0 22px; letter-spacing: -.008em; max-width: 28ch;}
.pl-news__form{display: flex; gap: 8px; max-width: 480px; margin-bottom: 14px;}
.pl-news__form input{flex: 1; min-width: 0; padding: 13px 18px; border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, .22); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .08); font: 400 14px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; color: #fff; transition: border-color .18s ease, background .18s ease;}
.pl-news__form input::placeholder{color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .55);}
.pl-news__form input:focus{outline: none; border-color: #fff; background: rgba(255, 255, 255, .14);}
.pl-news__form button{padding: 13px 24px; border: 1.5px solid #fff; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; color: var(--ink, #111); font: 600 13px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background .18s ease, color .18s ease; white-space: nowrap;}
.pl-news__form button:hover{background: transparent; color: #fff;}
.pl-news__note{font: 400 12px/1.5 'Inter', sans-serif; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, .6); margin: 0;}
@media (max-width: 600px){
  .pl-news{padding: 26px 22px; border-radius: 10px;}
  .pl-news__title{font-size: 21px; margin-bottom: 18px; line-height: 1.22;}
  .pl-news__form{flex-direction: column; gap: 10px;}
  .pl-news__form button{width: 100%;}
}

Use it when

  • .pl-brand after the lead on a sponsored story, for the presenting brand only
  • .pl-ad for a display placement, labelled Advertisement, with data-slot-audience so subscribers do not see it
  • .pl-news mid-article, hidden by the audience filter for readers who already subscribe
  • Match the story's sponsor: a sponsor profile belongs only on a story that brand presents

Avoid

  • A slot before the lead paragraph. Editorial comes first
  • A second paid unit next to the disclosure strip or another slot
  • Sponsor attribution on a story the sponsor did not present

API

NameTypeWhat it does
data-slot-typeattributebrand_profile | ad_display | newsletter_signup.
data-slot-id / data-slot-size / data-slot-audienceattributeSlot key, boxed or standard, and all | logged_out.
.art-slot:emptystateAn unfilled slot renders a dashed placeholder in the prototype.
.pl-brand__factsslotUp to three label and value facts about the sponsor.

Source _dev/reference/components/article-slots.html

Interview Q&A

Paste Inline CSS: paste it too

Question and answer pairs for an interview piece. Each question and answer opens with a small initials tag for who is speaking; answers set heavier than questions.

Needs/dist/styles.min.css/design-listing.css
Where
Used on 3 pages

design-article.html ghartalks-article.html voices-article.html

Guidelines
Inline family. Byte-identical copies in design-article.html, voices-article.html (source here) and ghartalks-article.html. Ships live on voices-article.html and ghartalks-article.html.
Preview 
<div class="art-qa">
  <div class="art-qa__pair">
    <p class="art-qa__q"><span class="art-qa__role">AB</span><span class="art-qa__q-text">The journalist's question.</span></p>
    <p class="art-qa__a"><span class="art-qa__role">CD</span><span class="art-qa__a-text">The subject's answer, as said.</span></p>
  </div>
</div>
.art-qa{margin: 32px 0; display: grid; gap: 28px;}
.art-qa__pair{display: grid; gap: 12px;}
.art-qa__q, .art-qa__a{margin: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 56px 1fr; column-gap: 18px; align-items: baseline;}
.art-qa__role{font: 700 10px/1.2 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); text-align: right; padding-top: 6px;}
.art-qa__q .art-qa__role{color: var(--ink, #111);}
.art-qa__q-text, .art-qa__a-text{font: 500 17px/1.65 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #111); margin: 0;}
.art-qa__a-text{font-weight: 400; color: var(--ink2, #374151);}
@media (max-width: 600px){
  .art-qa__q, .art-qa__a{grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 6px;}
  .art-qa__role{text-align: left; padding-top: 0;}
  .art-qa__q-text, .art-qa__a-text{font-size: 15.5px;}
}

Use it when

  • Voices interview pieces and GharTalks write-ups, inside .art-body
  • Initials of the journalist on questions, initials of the subject on answers
  • Pair with the speaker strip under the hero so the subject is credited in full (see article-callout)

Avoid

  • Paraphrased answers. What sits in .art-qa__a is what the person said
  • Conflating journalist and subject. The byline is the journalist; the subject is the speaker strip

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.art-qa__pairclassOne exchange: p.art-qa__q then p.art-qa__a.
.art-qa__roleslotInitials of who is speaking.
.art-qa__q-text / .art-qa__a-textslotThe question and the answer.

Source _dev/reference/components/article-qa.html

More from, across Ghar.tv and related

Paste Inline CSS: paste it too

The discovery sections after a story, outside the body column: .art-section with a compact section head, holding either a three-up .art-card-grid of image cards (More from the series, Related) or an .art-across-list of type-only cards pointing to the same subject in other verticals.

Needs/dist/styles.min.css/design-listing.css
Where
Used on 2 pages

design-article.html voices-article.html

Inline family. Byte-identical copies in design-article.html (source here), voices-article.html and ghartalks-article.html. On ghartalks-article.html the related row uses .gtk-grid and .gtk-card instead of .art-card-grid.

<section class="art-section" aria-label="More from Series name">

</section>

<section class="art-section" aria-label="Subject across Ghar.tv">
  <div class="section-head section-head--compact">
    <div class="section-head__text">
      <h2 class="sec-title sec-title--sub">Across Ghar.tv</h2>
    </div>
    <a href="/people/person-slug" class="section-head__link">
      See full profile
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14M13 5l7 7-7 7"/></svg>
    </a>

      <h3 class="art-across-card__title">Episode title</h3>

</section>
.art-section{max-width: 1280px; margin: 0 auto; padding: clamp(64px, 8vw, 96px) clamp(24px, 4vw, 56px); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8);}
.art-section > .section-head, .art-section > .art-card-grid, .art-section > .art-across-list{max-width: 1064px; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto;}
.art-section > .section-head{margin-bottom: 36px;}
.art-card-grid{max-width: 1064px; margin: 0 auto; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 32px;}
@media (max-width: 899px){
  .art-card-grid{grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;}
}
@media (max-width: 599px){
  .art-card-grid{grid-template-columns: 1fr;}
}
.art-card{display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; color: inherit; text-decoration: none;}
.art-card__media{aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--rule, #e8e8e8);}
.art-card__media img{display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform .8s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1);}
.art-card:hover .art-card__media img{transform: scale(1.04);}
.art-card__eyebrow{font: 600 10px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6e655b);}
.art-card__title{font-family: 'Gazpacho', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.24; color: var(--ink, #111); margin: 0;}
.art-card__meta{font: 400 12px/1.4 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); margin-top: auto;}
.art-across-list{max-width: 1064px; margin: 0 auto; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 24px;}
@media (max-width: 899px){
  .art-across-list{grid-template-columns: 1fr;}
}
.art-across-card{display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px; padding: 28px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8); border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: border-color .2s ease, transform .2s ease;}
.art-across-card:hover{border-color: var(--ink, #111); transform: translateY(-2px);}
.art-across-card__kind{font: 600 10px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6e655b);}
.art-across-card__title{font-family: 'Gazpacho', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.3; color: var(--ink, #111); margin: 0;}
.art-across-card__meta{font: 400 12px/1.4 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); margin-top: auto;}

Use it when

  • After the article body and before the newsletter: series first, then Across Ghar.tv, then Related
  • .art-across-card for the subject's episodes, films and essays elsewhere on the portal, each with a kind label
  • The head is the shared .section-head--compact with a .section-head__link

Avoid

  • Repeating the story the reader just finished, or a story already in the series nav
  • Images on across cards. They are type-only by design

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.art-sectionclassSection wrapper; spaces its head, grid and list.
.art-cardclassWhole-card anchor: __media img, __eyebrow, __title, __meta.
.art-across-cardclassType-only card: __kind (Vertical &middot; Type), __title, __meta.

Source _dev/reference/components/article-related.html

Photo carousel, audio card and map

Paste Inline CSS: paste it too

Media blocks inside a story body: a horizontal scroll-snap photo carousel whose frames open in the lightbox, an audio episode card linking to a GharTalks episode, and a static map snapshot with a pin and caption.

Needs/dist/styles.min.css/design-listing.css
Where
Used on 1 page

design-article.html

Inline family. Byte-identical copies in design-article.html (source here), voices-article.html and ghartalks-article.html. .pswp-link{display: block; position: relative; cursor: zoom-in; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;}
.pswp-link::after{content: ''; position: absolute; top: 12px; right: 12px; width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; background: url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' viewBox='0 0 24 24' fill='none' stroke='%23111' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round' stroke-linejoin='round'><path d='M15 3h6v6M14 10l7-7M9 21H3v-6M10 14l-7 7'/></svg>") center / 16px no-repeat, rgba(255, 255, 255, .92); opacity: 0; transform: translateY(-3px); transition: opacity .2s ease, transform .2s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); pointer-events: none; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, .12);}
.pswp-link:hover::after, .pswp-link:focus-visible::after{opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0);}
@media (max-width: 600px){
  .pswp-link::after{display: none;}
}
.art-audio{margin: 40px 0; padding: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8); border-radius: 12px; background: #fff; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 84px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 18px; align-items: center; text-decoration: none; transition: border-color .2s ease, transform .2s ease, box-shadow .2s ease;}
.art-audio:hover{border-color: var(--ink, #111); transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow: 0 6px 18px -10px rgba(0,0,0,.18);}
.art-audio__cover{width: 84px; height: 84px; border-radius: 8px; object-fit: cover; background: var(--ink, #111); flex-shrink: 0;}
.art-audio__body{min-width: 0;}
.art-audio__label{font: 700 10px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); margin: 0 0 8px;}
.art-audio__title{font: 600 16px/1.35 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #111); margin: 0 0 6px; display: -webkit-box; -webkit-line-clamp: 2; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; overflow: hidden; letter-spacing: -.005em;}
.art-audio__meta{font: 400 12.5px/1.4 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); margin: 0;}
.art-audio__play{width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #111); background: #fff; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: var(--ink, #111); flex-shrink: 0; transition: background .2s ease, color .2s ease, transform .2s ease;}
.art-audio:hover .art-audio__play{background: var(--ink); color: #fff; transform: scale(1.04);}
.art-audio__play svg{width: 16px; height: 16px; margin-left: 2px;}
@media (max-width: 600px){
  .art-audio{grid-template-columns: 64px minmax(0, 1fr) auto; gap: 14px; padding: 12px;}
  .art-audio__cover{width: 64px; height: 64px;}
  .art-audio__title{font-size: 14.5px;}
  .art-audio__label{font-size: 9.5px;}
  .art-audio__meta{font-size: 11.5px;}
  .art-audio__play{width: 42px; height: 42px;}
}
.art-map{margin: 48px 0;}
.art-map__frame{position: relative; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; border-radius: 8px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--rule, #e8e8e8);}
.art-map__frame img{display: block; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover;}
.art-map__pin{position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 50%; transform: translate(-50%, -100%); color: var(--accent, #ee324b); filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.35));}
.art-map__pin svg{width: 28px; height: 28px;}
.art-map figcaption{display: flex; justify-content: space-between; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px; font: 400 12px/1.5 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); margin-top: 14px;}
.art-carousel{margin: 48px 0;}
.art-carousel__track{display: flex; gap: 14px; overflow-x: auto; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; scrollbar-width: thin; padding-bottom: 12px; margin-left: calc(-1 * clamp(8px, 1.5vw, 16px)); margin-right: calc(-1 * clamp(8px, 1.5vw, 16px)); padding-left: clamp(8px, 1.5vw, 16px); padding-right: clamp(8px, 1.5vw, 16px);}
.art-carousel__track::-webkit-scrollbar{height: 6px;}
.art-carousel__track::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background: var(--rule, #e8e8e8); border-radius: 3px;}
.art-carousel__item{flex: 0 0 calc((100% - 28px) / 3); scroll-snap-align: start; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px;}
.art-carousel__item img{display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--rule, #e8e8e8);}
.art-carousel__caption{font: 400 12px/1.5 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #6e655b);}
.art-carousel__credit{font: 400 12px/1.5 'Inter', sans-serif; font-style: italic; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); margin: 14px 0 0; text-align: right;}
@media (max-width: 900px){
  .art-carousel__item{flex-basis: calc((100% - 14px) / 2);}
}
@media (max-width: 600px){
  .art-carousel__item{flex-basis: 78%;}
}

Use it when

  • .art-carousel for a walk-through of four to six photos with short captions and one credit
  • .art-audio when the story directly cites an episode; it links to the episode page
  • .art-map when location grounds the story

Avoid

  • Playing audio inline. The card is a link to the episode page
  • A live map embed. The map is a static image with a pin
  • A video block here. Films use the facade (see video-facade)

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.art-carousel__track / __itemclassScroll-snap track; each item is a pswp-link image and a __caption.
.art-audio__playslotPlay disc inside the link. Decorative; the whole card navigates.
.art-map__pinslotPin glyph over .art-map__frame.

Series strip, short version, TOC and takeaways

Paste Inline CSS: paste it too

The orientation blocks at the top of a story body: the series strip (Part n of m in Series name), the short-version summary, the collapsible In this story contents list built from the body's h2s, and a key takeaways bullet list.

Needs/dist/styles.min.css/design-listing.css
Where
Used on 3 pages

design-article.html ghartalks-article.html voices-article.html

Inline family. Byte-identical copies in design-article.html (source here), voices-article.html and ghartalks-article.html. The TOC script is inline on all three; it guards #artTocCount, which only design-article.html carries. .art-takeaways renders only in the hidden block reference on design-article.html but ships live on voices-article.html and ghartalks-article.html.
Preview 
<aside class="art-series-strip" aria-label="Series">
  <span class="art-series-strip__label">Part 1 of 4</span>

    Series name

  </a>
</aside>

<aside class="art-tldr" aria-label="Summary">
  <p class="art-tldr__label">The short version</p>
  <p class="art-tldr__body">Two or three sentences that tell the reader what the story says.</p>
</aside>

<details class="art-toc" id="artToc">
  <summary class="art-toc__summary">
    <span>In this story</span>
    <span class="art-toc__count">
      <span id="artTocCount">0</span> sections
      <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M6 9l6 6 6-6"/></svg>
    </span>
  </summary>
  <ol class="art-toc__list" id="artTocList"></ol>
</details>

<aside class="art-takeaways" aria-label="Key takeaways">
  <span class="art-takeaways__label">Key takeaways</span>
  <ul class="art-takeaways__list">
    <li>A takeaway stated as a fact from the story.</li>
    <li>A second takeaway.</li>
  </ul>

.art-toc{margin: 20px 0 36px; padding: 14px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8);}
.art-toc__summary{display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; font: 700 10px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6e655b);}
.art-toc__summary::-webkit-details-marker{display: none;}
.art-toc__count{display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 500 11px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; text-transform: none; color: var(--ink, #111);}
.art-toc__chev{width: 14px; height: 14px; flex-shrink: 0; transition: transform .25s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1); color: var(--ink, #111);}
.art-toc[open] .art-toc__chev{transform: rotate(180deg);}
.art-toc .art-toc__list{list-style: none; padding: 18px 0 4px; margin: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 10px 28px; counter-reset: toc;}
.art-toc .art-toc__list li{counter-increment: toc; padding: 0; margin: 0; min-width: 0; list-style: none;}
.art-toc__list a{display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 10px; padding: 4px 0; text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink, #111); font: 500 14px/1.4 'Inter', sans-serif; transition: color .18s ease;}
.art-toc__list a::before{content: counter(toc, decimal-leading-zero); font: 700 10px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); flex-shrink: 0; padding-top: 3px;}
.art-toc__list a:hover{color: var(--accent, #ee324b);}
.art-toc__list a:hover::before{color: var(--accent, #ee324b);}
@media (max-width: 600px){
  .art-toc__list{grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 4px;}
  .art-toc__list a{font-size: 13.5px;}
}
.art-series-strip{display: flex; align-items: baseline; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin: 0 0 28px; padding: 0 0 14px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8); text-align: center;}
.art-series-strip__label{font: 700 10px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6e655b);}
.art-series-strip__in{font: 400 12px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #6e655b);}
.art-series-strip__name{font: 600 13px/1.3 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #111); text-decoration: none; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; transition: gap .2s ease;}
.art-series-strip__name:hover{gap: 10px;}
.art-series-strip__name svg{width: 12px; height: 12px;}
.art-tldr{margin: 28px 0 32px; padding: 22px 26px; background: #f7f1e1; border-radius: 10px; border-left: 4px solid #d49f40;}
.art-tldr__label{display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font: 700 10px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #8a6d2a; margin: 0 0 10px;}
.art-tldr__label::before{content: ''; width: 14px; height: 1px; background: #d49f40;}
.art-tldr .art-tldr__body{font: 500 16px/1.6 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #111); margin: 0;}
@media (max-width: 600px){
  .art-tldr{padding: 18px 20px;}
  .art-tldr .art-tldr__body{font-size: 15px;}
}
.art-takeaways{margin: 32px 0; padding: 24px 28px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8); border-radius: 10px;}
.art-takeaways__label{display: block; font: 700 10px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); margin: 0 0 14px;}
.art-takeaways .art-takeaways__list{list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; display: grid; gap: 12px;}
.art-takeaways .art-takeaways__list li{position: relative; padding-left: 22px; font: 500 15px/1.55 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #111); margin: 0; list-style: none;}
.art-takeaways__list li::before{content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; top: 8px; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink, #111);}
@media (max-width: 600px){
  .art-takeaways{padding: 20px 22px;}
  .art-takeaways__list li{font-size: 14px; padding-left: 18px;}
  .art-takeaways__list li::before{width: 6px; height: 6px; top: 7px;}
}
(function(){
  var toc = document.getElementById('artToc');
  var list = document.getElementById('artTocList');
  var count = document.getElementById('artTocCount');
  var body = document.querySelector('.art-body');
  if (!toc || !list || !body) return;
  var headings = body.querySelectorAll('h2');
  if (headings.length < 3) { toc.style.display = 'none'; return; }
  var slugify = function(s){
    return s.toLowerCase().replace(/[^\w\s-]/g,'').trim().replace(/\s+/g,'-').slice(0,60);
  };
  var seen = {};
  headings.forEach(function(h){
    var id = h.id || slugify(h.textContent);
    var base = id, i = 1;
    while (seen[id]) { i++; id = base + '-' + i; }
    seen[id] = true;
    h.id = id;
    var li = document.createElement('li');
    var a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = '#' + id;
    a.textContent = h.textContent;
    li.appendChild(a);
    list.appendChild(li);
  });
  if (count) count.textContent = headings.length;
})();

Use it when

  • .art-series-strip first in the body when the story belongs to a series
  • .art-tldr for a prose summary; .art-takeaways for fact-heavy stories as bullets, instead of or alongside it
  • .art-toc on long stories. The script fills the list from every h2 and hides the block when there are fewer than three

Avoid

  • Hand-writing the TOC list. It is generated so it cannot drift from the headings
  • Merging chapters into the TOC on an episode page. The TOC indexes the writing; chapters index the recording

API

NameTypeWhat it does
#artToc / #artTocList / #artTocCountidThe details element, the empty <ol> the script fills, and the optional count span.
.art-series-strip__nameclassLink to the series page.
.art-takeaways__listclassThe bullet <ul>.

A one-line note between the article hero and the body on a paid story: brand initial mark, Presented by and the brand name, a divider, and the Paid Partnership tag.

Where

design-article.html

Guidelines

<div class="art-disclosure-wrap">

.art-disclosure-wrap{max-width: 820px; margin: clamp(16px, 2vw, 22px) auto 0; padding: 0 clamp(24px, 4vw, 56px);}
.art-disclosure{display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8); font: 500 12.5px/1.4 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #111);}
.art-disclosure__mark{display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 22px; height: 22px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink, #111); color: #fff; font: 700 11px/1 'Gazpacho', Georgia, serif; flex-shrink: 0;}
.art-disclosure__line{color: var(--ink, #111);}
.art-disclosure__brand{font: 700 13px/1 'Gazpacho', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -.005em; color: var(--ink, #111); margin-left: 2px;}
.art-disclosure__divider{width: 1px; height: 12px; background: var(--rule, #d8d8d8);}
.art-disclosure__tag{font: 600 9.5px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6e655b);}
@media (max-width: 480px){
  .art-disclosure{font-size: 12px; gap: 8px;}
  .art-disclosure__mark{width: 20px; height: 20px; font-size: 10.5px;}
  .art-disclosure__brand{font-size: 12.5px;}
  .art-disclosure__tag{font-size: 9px; letter-spacing: .12em;}
}

Use it when

  • Directly under .art-hero on any sponsored or partnered story
  • Presented by for paid promotion; In Collaboration With for an editorial collaboration
  • Pair with an .art-note--disclosure near the foot of the body that says what the sponsor did and did not control

Avoid

  • Editorial-only stories
  • A hover state on the brand name. It is an identity anchor
  • Hiding it below the fold or inside the body. The reader is told before they start

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.art-disclosure__markslotBrand initial disc. aria-hidden.
.art-disclosure__brandslotBrand name; a link to /brands/{slug} in the design-system recipe.
.art-disclosure__tagslotPaid Partnership.

Data blocks inside a story body: the single big stat with caption, the stat strip of two to four figures, the two-column comparison with a vs divider, and the article table in its variants (zebra, cards on mobile, minimal, bordered, row-header).

Needs/dist/styles.min.css/design-listing.css
Where
Used on 3 pages

design-article.html ghartalks-article.html voices-article.html

Inline family. Byte-identical copies in design-article.html (source here), voices-article.html and ghartalks-article.html. Only the stat strip ships live on ghartalks-article.html; the other variants render in the hidden block reference on design-article.html or live on voices-article.html.

.art-stat{margin: 56px 0; text-align: center; padding: 36px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8);}

.art-table-wrap{margin: 40px 0; overflow-x: auto; -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;}

.art-table thead th{font: 600 11px/1.2 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); text-align: left; padding: 12px 24px 12px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--ink, #111); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8); white-space: nowrap;}

.art-compare{margin: 40px 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; column-gap: 20px; align-items: stretch;}

.art-compare__col--ink .art-compare__label{color: rgba(255,255,255,.65);}
.art-compare__col--ink .art-compare__title{color: #fff;}
.art-compare__col--ink .art-compare__body{color: rgba(255,255,255,.85);}
.art-compare__label{font: 700 9.5px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); margin: 0 0 4px;}
.art-compare .art-compare__title{font: 700 18px/1.25 'Gazpacho', Georgia, serif; color: var(--ink, #111); letter-spacing: -.005em; margin: 0;}
.art-compare__body{font: 400 14px/1.6 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--ink2, #374151); margin: 0;}
.art-compare__divider{align-self: center; font: 700 11px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8); border-radius: 999px; background: #fff;}
@media (max-width: 600px){
  .art-compare{grid-template-columns: 1fr; row-gap: 14px;}
  .art-compare__divider{justify-self: center;}
}

Use it when

  • .art-stat when one number is the point; .art-stat-strip for two to four smaller figures
  • .art-compare for this approach against that; --ink on the second column
  • .art-table--cards with data-th on each cell so rows stack as cards on a phone
  • .art-table--minimal for short values, --bordered for long cell text, --row-header for spec tables without a thead
  • Always wrap the table in .art-table-wrap

Avoid

  • Figures that are not in the reporting. Stats are early-stage truth, never illustrative
  • A stat strip of one. Use .art-stat

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.art-stat / .art-stat__num / .art-stat__captionclassOne big figure in Gazpacho with a caption.
.art-stat-strip__itemclassOne figure: .art-stat-strip__num and __label.
.art-compare__col--inkmodifierDark second column.
.art-table--zebra / --cards / --minimal / --bordered / --row-headermodifierTable treatments; --cards reads data-th from each td.

Source _dev/reference/components/article-data.html

.art-series-foot{max-width: 820px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 48px clamp(24px, 4vw, 56px) 40px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8);}
.art-series-foot__head{display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; margin-bottom: 24px;}
.art-series-foot__title{font: 700 11px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink, #111); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px;}
.art-series-foot__title em{font: 600 13px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0; text-transform: none; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); font-style: normal;}
.art-series-foot__progress{display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;}
.art-series-foot__progress span{width: 22px; height: 4px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--rule, #e8e8e8);}
.art-series-foot__progress span.is-done{background: var(--ink, #111);}
.art-series-foot__progress span.is-current{background: var(--accent, #ee324b);}
.art-series-foot__nav{display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 0;}
.art-series-foot__prev, .art-series-foot__next{display: grid; gap: 8px; padding: 22px 24px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8); text-decoration: none; color: var(--ink, #111); transition: border-color .18s ease, transform .18s ease;}
.art-series-foot__prev{border-radius: 10px 0 0 10px; border-right: 0;}
.art-series-foot__next{border-radius: 0 10px 10px 0; text-align: right;}
.art-series-foot__prev:hover, .art-series-foot__next:hover{border-color: var(--ink, #111); transform: translateY(-1px);}
.art-series-foot__dir{font: 700 9.5px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .18em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px;}
.art-series-foot__next .art-series-foot__dir{justify-content: flex-end;}
.art-series-foot__dir svg{width: 12px; height: 12px;}
.art-series-foot__story-title{font: 700 17px/1.3 'Gazpacho', Georgia, serif; color: var(--ink, #111); letter-spacing: -.005em;}
.art-series-foot__meta{font: 400 12px/1.4 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #6e655b);}
@media (max-width: 600px){
  .art-series-foot{padding: 36px 0 28px;}
  .art-series-foot__nav{grid-template-columns: 1fr;}
  .art-series-foot__prev, .art-series-foot__next{border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8); text-align: left;}
  .art-series-foot__prev{margin-bottom: 12px;}
  .art-series-foot__next .art-series-foot__dir{justify-content: flex-start;}
}
.art-tags-wrap{max-width: 820px; margin: 56px auto 0; padding: 32px 0 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8);}
.art-tags-wrap__label{font: 600 11px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); margin: 0 0 16px;}
.art-tags{display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px;}
.art-tag{display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8); font: 500 12px/1.2 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #111); text-decoration: none; transition: border-color .2s ease, background .2s ease, color .2s ease;}
.art-tag:hover{border-color: var(--ink, #111); background: var(--ink, #111); color: #fff;}
.art-credits{max-width: 820px; margin: 56px auto 0; padding: 40px 0 64px; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #e8e8e8);}
.art-credits__head{font: 600 11px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink, #111); margin: 0 0 28px;}
.art-credits__grid{display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(180px, 1fr)); gap: 36px;}
@media (max-width: 700px){
  .art-credits__grid{grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: 24px;}
}
.art-credits__col{display: flex; flex-direction: column;}
.art-credits__label{font: 600 10px/1 'Inter', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); margin-bottom: 14px;}
.art-credits__name{font: 600 14.5px/1.3 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #111); text-decoration: none; margin-bottom: 2px; display: block;}
.art-credits__role{font: 400 12px/1.4 'Inter', sans-serif; color: var(--muted, #6e655b); margin-bottom: 16px;}
.art-credits__role:last-child{margin-bottom: 0;}

Use it when

  • In this order at the end of .art-body: tags, credits, series nav
  • Each tag links to its taxonomy page; credit names link to /people or /brands when a profile exists, and stay plain text when not
  • .art-series-foot only on series stories; mark past parts .is-done and this part .is-current

Avoid

  • Linking a credit name that has no profile page
  • A next link on the last part of a series. Omit that side

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.art-tagsclassrole=list of a.art-tag role=listitem.
.art-credits__colclass.art-credits__label, then one or more __name and __role pairs.
.art-series-foot__progressslotOne span per part; .is-done and .is-current.
.art-series-foot__prev / __nextclassStory links with __dir, __story-title and __meta.

Source _dev/reference/components/article-end.html

.cta{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--ink);color:#fff;border-radius:calc(var(--r) + 8px); padding:clamp(54px,7vw,88px) clamp(28px,5vw,56px);text-align:center;box-shadow:var(--sh); background-image:radial-gradient(60% 60% at 50% -10%,rgba(237, 164, 28,.16) 0%,transparent 62%),radial-gradient(50% 55% at 88% 112%,rgba(213, 97, 58,.14) 0%,transparent 60%)}
.cta__wm{position:absolute;left:-5%;top:-34%;width:min(42vw,360px);opacity:.06;pointer-events:none}
.cta__wm path{fill:#fff}
.cta__inner{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:640px;margin:0 auto}
.cta__eyebrow{display:inline-block;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.55);margin-bottom:18px}
.cta h2{color:#fff;margin:0 auto 18px;max-width:18ch}
.cta p{color:rgba(255,255,255,.74);margin:0 auto 36px;max-width:48ch;font-size:clamp(15px,1.7vw,17.5px);line-height:1.7}
.cta__contact{margin:44px auto 0;padding-top:30px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:16px 14px}
.cta__chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;text-decoration:none;padding:10px 20px 10px 12px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);transition:border-color .25s,background .25s}
.cta__chip:hover{border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.3);background:rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
.cta__chip-ic{width:38px;height:38px;border-radius:50%;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16);color:#fff}
.cta__chip-ic svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.cta__chip-tx{text-align:left;line-height:1.25}
.cta__chip-tx .lbl{display:block;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.5)}
.cta__chip-tx .val{display:block;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#fff}

Use it when

  • Final band, id="contact", the target of every #contact link on the page
  • One primary .btn that opens the brief or enquiry flow
  • Chips carry the real contact routes: phone or WhatsApp, and email

Avoid

  • A second button in the card
  • A placeholder phone number going live
  • Placing it mid-page

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.cta__innerslot.cta__eyebrow, h2.disp, p, .btn, .cta__contact.
.cta__chipclass.cta__chip-ic plus .cta__chip-tx with .lbl and .val.

Used on 3 pages

brand-connect.html design-partner-kit.html for-brands.html

<div class="market">

      <li><span class="aud-ic"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9"/><path d="M12 8v4l3 2"/></svg></span> Audience four</li>

.market{position:relative;margin-top:clamp(20px,2.4vw,26px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;align-items:stretch;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:var(--r);box-shadow:var(--sh);overflow:hidden}
.market__stat{background:#fff;padding:clamp(28px,3.4vw,38px);display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.market__cap{font:700 11px/1.3 "Inter",sans-serif;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--indigo);margin:0 0 12px}
.market__num{font-family:"Gazpacho",Georgia,serif;font-weight:700;font-size:clamp(34px,4.6vw,52px);line-height:1;color:var(--ink);margin:0}
.market__num span{color:var(--indigo)}
.market__grow{align-self:flex-start;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;margin-top:16px;font:700 12px/1 "Inter",sans-serif;color:#3a4a80;background:#ebeef3;padding:8px 13px;border-radius:999px}
.market__lbl{font-size:14.5px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--espresso);margin:18px 0 0;max-width:42ch}
.market__lbl b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.market__src{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);margin:13px 0 0;line-height:1.5}
.market__who{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#faf7f2;padding:clamp(28px,3.4vw,38px) clamp(28px,3.4vw,38px) clamp(28px,3.4vw,38px) clamp(58px,5.5vw,74px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;clip-path:polygon(0 0, 100% 0, 100% 100%, 0 100%, 50px 50%)}
.market__who-bg{position:absolute;right:-12%;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);width:min(64%,250px);height:auto;opacity:.13;color:var(--indigo);pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.market__who-lbl,.market__who .aud-list{position:relative;z-index:1}
.market__who-lbl{font:700 10.5px/1 "Inter",sans-serif;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--indigo);margin:0 0 20px}
.aud-list{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:15px}
.aud-list li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;font-size:14.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--ink);line-height:1.3}
.aud-ic{flex-shrink:0;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--rule);box-shadow:var(--sh-sm);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:var(--indigo)}
.aud-ic svg{width:18px;height:18px}
@media(max-width:820px){
  .market__who{clip-path:none;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);padding-left:clamp(28px,3.4vw,38px)}
}

Use it when

  • Inside the why band, after b2b-why
  • One public, sourced sector figure, labelled as sector size and not Ghar.tv data, with the source in .market__src
  • Audience groups in plain words, four at most

Avoid

  • A Ghar.tv traffic, reader or lead number. The platform is early stage; sell on audience quality and intent
  • A figure without a source line
  • More than one number in the card

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.market__statslot.market__cap, .market__num (span for the suffix), .market__grow, .market__lbl, .market__src.
.market__whoslotRings svg, .market__who-lbl and ul.aud-list of li > .aud-ic plus text.

B2B packages

Paste Inline CSS: paste it too

Three tier cards side by side: a tinted top with badge, name, one-line promise and who it is for, a checklist body where each tier inherits the one before, and a CTA; the middle tier is featured with a deeper shadow and a dark CTA, and moves first when the grid stacks.

Needs/gazpacho.csscss2
Where
Used on 2 pages

brand-connect.html for-brands.html

Inline family; needs b2b-section. Source for-brands.html (21 rules). brand-connect.html (22) and design-partner-kit.html (15) carry diverged copies of the same selectors. Tier hexes (#9aa890, #5f71a9) are hard-coded, one of them a stale sage.

.packs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:22px;margin-top:6px;align-items:stretch}
.pack--p1{--c:#9aa890;--cd:#5f6e57;--ctint:#f2f4ef}
.pack--p2{--c:#eda41c;--cd:#a07628;--ctint:#fbf3e3}
.pack--p3{--c:#5f71a9;--cd:#56647e;--ctint:#eef0f4}
.pack{border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:var(--r);overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--sh);transition:transform .3s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),box-shadow .3s}
.pack:not(.pack--feature):hover{transform:translateY(-4px);box-shadow:0 30px 60px -36px rgba(58,53,48,.4)}
.pack--feature{border:none;box-shadow:0 44px 86px -42px rgba(160,118,40,.6);position:relative;z-index:2}
.pack__top{padding:26px 28px 24px;border-bottom:none;color:#fff;background:var(--c); background-image:radial-gradient(135% 100% at 86% 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.42) 0%,transparent 58%), radial-gradient(90% 90% at 4% 116%,rgba(0,0,0,.10) 0%,transparent 56%)}
.pack__badge{display:inline-block;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--cd);background:#fff;padding:5px 11px;border-radius:999px;margin-bottom:13px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.06)}
.pack__name{font-family:"Gazpacho",serif;font-weight:700;font-size:29px;color:#fff;line-height:1.06;margin-bottom:7px}
.pack__line{font-size:13.5px;font-weight:600;color:#fff}
.pack__for{font-size:13px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.9);line-height:1.5;margin-top:12px}
.pack__price{margin-top:18px;padding-top:16px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.3);font-family:"Gazpacho",Georgia,serif;font-weight:700;font-size:30px;line-height:1;color:#fff}
.pack__price i{font-family:"Inter",sans-serif;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;font-style:normal;color:rgba(255,255,255,.82);letter-spacing:.01em}
.pack__body{padding:22px 28px 28px;flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.pack__body ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;flex:1}
.pack__body li{position:relative;padding:10px 0 10px 28px;font-size:14.5px;color:var(--espresso);line-height:1.45;border-bottom:1px solid #f0eadf}
.pack__body li:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.pack__body li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:3px;top:14px;width:12px;height:7px;border-left:2px solid var(--cd);border-bottom:2px solid var(--cd);transform:rotate(-45deg)}
.pack__body li.pack__inherit{padding:0 0 12px;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted); text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em;border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule)}
.pack__body li.pack__inherit::before{display:none}
.pack__body li.pack__inherit b{color:var(--cd);font-weight:700}
.pack__cta{margin-top:22px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;width:100%; padding:14px 20px;border-radius:999px;font:600 15px/1 "Inter",sans-serif;text-decoration:none; border:1.5px solid var(--cd);color:var(--cd);background:#fff; transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),background .25s,color .25s,border-color .25s}
.pack__cta svg{width:15px;height:15px;transition:transform .25s}
.pack__cta:hover{background:var(--cd);color:#fff;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.pack__cta:hover svg{transform:translateX(3px)}
.pack--feature .pack__cta{background:var(--ink);border-color:var(--ink);color:#fff}
.pack--feature .pack__cta:hover{background:#000;border-color:#000}
.packs__note{margin-top:30px;text-align:center;font-size:15px;color:var(--espresso)}
.packs__note b{color:var(--ink)}
@media(max-width:920px){
  .packs{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:18px;max-width:480px;margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto}
  .pack--feature{transform:none;order:-1}
  .pack:not(.pack--feature):hover{transform:none}
}
@media(max-width:820px){
  .pack--feature{transform:none}
}
@media print{
  .pack,.why__card,.chan,.arcstep{page-break-inside:avoid}
  .pack--feature{transform:none}
}

Use it when

  • The Ways to partner band, id="packages", after the surface map
  • Three tiers, p1 to p3, with the middle one .pack--feature
  • Start tiers two and three with .pack__inherit so each builds on the last
  • A .packs__note under the grid saying the team shapes the plan

Avoid

  • Prices on the cards or the public page; rates stay on the internal rate card
  • A fourth tier
  • More than one featured tier

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.pack--p1 / --p2 / --p3modifierSets --c, --cd and --ctint for the tier colour.
.pack--featuremodifierFeatured tier: no border, deeper shadow, dark CTA, order -1 when stacked.
.pack__inheritclassFirst list item: Everything in <b>tier</b>, plus.
.packs__noteclassCentred note under the grid.
