B2B page band, tokens and type

Paste Inline CSS: paste it too

The base every modern B2B page (Brand Connect, For Brands, Design partner kit) builds on: page tokens on :root, a full-bleed .band with a .band--warm alternate, a 1140px .wrap, the numbered .eyebrow, a Gazpacho h2, .lead and .sub copy, and the red .btn with a white .btn-ghost.

Needs/gazpacho.csscss2
Where
Used on 3 pages

brand-connect.html design-partner-kit.html for-brands.html

Inline family. for-brands.html is the source; brand-connect.html and design-partner-kit.html carry copies. :root, .wrap, .eyebrow and .disp are byte-identical on all three; .band differs on design-partner-kit.html, .lead and .sub differ on design-partner-kit.html, .btn is missing from brand-connect.html's page style. The page tokens carry stale theme hexes (--sage #9aa890, --indigo #7f8ca6) that no longer match styles.css.
Preview 
<section class="band band--warm" style="--acc:var(--indigo)">
  <div class="wrap">
    <p class="eyebrow"><span class="n">01</span> Section label</p>
    <h2 class="disp">A benefit-led headline.</h2>
    <p class="lead">One or two plain sentences on what the brand gets. <b>The key point in bold.</b></p>
    <p class="sub">A shorter supporting line.</p>
    <a class="btn" href="#contact"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 15a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7l-4 4V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"/></svg> Let's talk</a>
    <a class="btn-ghost" href="#packages">See packages</a>
  </div>
</section>
:root{
  --bg:#ffffff; --warm:#faf7f2; --panel:#f6f1e9; --ink:#1a1714; --espresso:#3a2f27; --muted:#736b62; --rule:#e7e0d4;
  --turmeric:#eda41c; --terracotta:#d5613a; --terracotta-dk:#a85f43; --sand:#e0c199; --sage:#9aa890; --indigo:#7f8ca6;
  --red:#ee324b;
  --r:20px; --rs:13px; --wrap:1140px;
  --pv:clamp(64px,9vw,128px); --ph:clamp(22px,5vw,76px);
  --sh-sm:0 2px 4px rgba(58,53,48,.04);
  --sh:0 30px 60px -44px rgba(58,53,48,.5), 0 4px 12px -8px rgba(58,53,48,.12);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;padding:0;background:var(--bg);color:var(--espresso); font-family:"Inter",-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",Arial,sans-serif; font-size:15px;line-height:1.62;-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;}
.disp{font-family:"Gazpacho",Georgia,serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:normal}
.band{padding:var(--pv) var(--ph);background:var(--bg);position:relative}
.band--warm{background:var(--warm)}
.wrap{max-width:var(--wrap);margin:0 auto;position:relative;z-index:1}
.eyebrow{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 22px}
.eyebrow .n{font-family:"Gazpacho",serif;font-weight:700;font-size:15px;letter-spacing:0;color:var(--acc,var(--terracotta))}
.eyebrow .n::after{content:"";display:inline-block;width:24px;height:1.5px;background:var(--rule);margin:0 0 4px 11px;vertical-align:middle}
h2{font-family:"Gazpacho",Georgia,serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:normal; font-size:clamp(30px,4.6vw,52px);line-height:1.06;color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 20px;max-width:18ch}
.lead{font-size:clamp(16px,1.75vw,20px);line-height:1.6;color:var(--espresso);max-width:60ch;margin:0}
.lead b{color:var(--ink)}
.sub{font-size:clamp(15px,1.6vw,18px);color:var(--muted);max-width:62ch;margin:0 0 40px;line-height:1.62}
strong{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.q-shape{display:inline-block;width:1.22em;height:1.22em;vertical-align:baseline;position:relative;top:.22em;margin:0 .05em;line-height:0}
.q-shape svg{width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:var(--red);color:#fff;font-weight:600;font-size:16px;padding:17px 38px;border-radius:999px;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:0 14px 30px -16px rgba(238,50,75,.55);transition:transform .25s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),box-shadow .25s}
.btn svg{width:17px;height:17px}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 20px 38px -16px rgba(238,50,75,.7)}
.btn-ghost{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;background:#fff;color:var(--ink);font-weight:600;font-size:15.5px;padding:16px 30px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid var(--rule);text-decoration:none;box-shadow:0 14px 30px -14px rgba(26,23,20,.28);transition:background .25s,transform .25s,box-shadow .25s,border-color .25s}
.btn-ghost:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 20px 40px -15px rgba(26,23,20,.34)}
.btn-ghost svg{width:16px;height:16px}
@media print{
  .band--warm,.smap,.cta,.pack--feature .pack__top,.why__ic,.market__who,.chan,.arcstep,.pack,.stat,.aud-ic,.cta__chip-ic,.cta__chip,.howstep .n{-webkit-print-color-adjust:exact;print-color-adjust:exact}
  h2{page-break-after:avoid}
}

Use it when

  • Only on a standalone B2B sales page that loads no portal page chassis; every other b2b-* component expects these tokens and base rules
  • Alternate .band and .band--warm down the page; number eyebrows 01, 02, 03 in order and set --acc per band to rotate the number colour
  • Copy that is benefit-led and plain: lead with what the brand gets and the portal advantage
  • One .btn per band at most, paired with a .btn-ghost when there is a second route

Avoid

  • Pasting the :root block into a portal page. It redefines --ink, --muted, --rule, --sage and --indigo with page values that differ from styles.css
  • The bare h2 and strong rules on a page that has its own heading styles
  • Fabricated audience or performance numbers; the platform is early stage
  • Prices on the public page

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.band / .band--warmclassFull-bleed section with --pv and --ph padding; warm alternate background.
.wrapclassCentred column at --wrap (1140px).
.eyebrow .nslotSection number in Gazpacho, coloured by --acc (default terracotta).
--acctokenPer-band accent for the eyebrow number.
.btn / .btn-ghostclassPage-local red pill and white outline pill; not the portal .btn-text.

Source _dev/reference/components/b2b-section.html

B2B page hero

Paste Inline CSS: paste it too

The opening band of a B2B sales page: Ghar.tv wordmark with a product tag, a two-line Gazpacho headline that can carry masked photo glyphs inline, a lede, the red and ghost CTA pair, and a Built for row of audience chips, over a faint G watermark.

Needs/gazpacho.csscss2
Where
Used on 2 pages

brand-connect.html for-brands.html

Inline family; needs b2b-section. Source for-brands.html; brand-connect.html (24 rules, adds a .hero__chip--more expand chip) and design-partner-kit.html (15 rules, adds .hero__cats and .hero__base) carry diverged copies. Every .hero rule differs across the three pages. Mask ids (ghM1, ghM2) must be unique per page.

.hero{padding-top:clamp(40px,6vw,64px);overflow:hidden}
.hero__wm{position:absolute;right:-3%;bottom:-22%;width:min(54vw,540px);opacity:.06;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.hero__wm path{fill:var(--terracotta)}
.hero__top{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;gap:16px;margin-bottom:clamp(48px,9vw,104px)}
.hero__top svg{height:30px;width:auto}
.hero__top svg path{fill:var(--red)}
.hero__tag{font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);padding-left:16px;border-left:1px solid var(--rule)}
.hero h1{font-family:"Gazpacho",Georgia,serif;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:normal; font-size:clamp(38px,6.7vw,82px);line-height:0;color:var(--ink);margin:0 0 30px; display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}
.hero h1 .t-line{display:block;white-space:nowrap;margin-top:-0.1em}
.hero__lede{font-size:clamp(17px,2.05vw,23px);line-height:1.5;color:var(--espresso);max-width:52ch;margin:0}
.hero__lede b{color:var(--ink);font-weight:600}
.hero__for{margin-top:clamp(40px,6vw,64px);padding-top:24px;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 9px;align-items:center}
.hero__for-lbl{font-size:11.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);margin-right:6px}
.hero__chip{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:600;color:var(--espresso);background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--rule);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 14px;line-height:1;box-shadow:var(--sh-sm)}
.hero__cta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:13px;margin-top:clamp(30px,4vw,40px)}
.hero__cta .btn svg,.hero__cta .btn-ghost svg{width:20px;height:20px}

Use it when

  • First band of a modern B2B page, id="main" for the skip link
  • Product name in .hero__tag; the name stands alone, no descriptor
  • Each .t-line is one line of the headline and never wraps; keep lines short enough for a phone
  • The lede says what the brand gets, with the key phrase in <b>

Avoid

  • More than two .q-shape glyphs, or glyphs on a page that is not a showcase of Ghar.tv's own shapes
  • Long .t-line text. white-space:nowrap means a long line overflows at 390px
  • Audience numbers in the lede

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.hero__topslotWordmark svg plus .hero__tag product label.
.t-line / .q-shapeclassHeadline lines; inline masked image glyph (SVG mask over an image).
.hero__ctaslot.btn plus .btn-ghost.
.hero__for / .hero__chipslotLabel and audience chips under a top rule.

Source _dev/reference/components/b2b-hero.html

.smap{overflow:hidden;background:#17130f; background-image:radial-gradient(46% 42% at 14% 16%,rgba(237, 164, 28,.16) 0%,transparent 60%),radial-gradient(46% 46% at 86% 22%,rgba(243,126,134,.12) 0%,transparent 60%),radial-gradient(50% 50% at 70% 96%,rgba(127,140,166,.16) 0%,transparent 62%)}
.smap::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(45deg,rgba(255,255,255,.05) 0 1px,transparent 1px 14px);pointer-events:none}
.smap .wrap{position:relative;z-index:1}
.smap__wm{position:absolute;left:-5%;bottom:-30%;width:min(46vw,440px);opacity:.08;pointer-events:none;z-index:0}
.smap__wm path{fill:#fff}
.smap .eyebrow{color:rgba(255,255,255,.8)}
.smap .eyebrow .n{color:#fff}
.smap .eyebrow .n::after{background:rgba(255,255,255,.4)}
.smap h2{color:#fff}
.smap__lead{font-size:clamp(16px,1.75vw,20px);line-height:1.6;color:rgba(255,255,255,.9);max-width:62ch;margin:0}
.smap__lead b{color:#fff}
.smap__grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px;margin-top:clamp(38px,4.5vw,52px)}
.pillar{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.pillar__hd{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-bottom:16px;padding-bottom:15px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.16)}
.pillar__dot{width:11px;height:11px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--c);flex-shrink:0;box-shadow:0 0 16px -2px var(--c)}
.pillar__name{font:700 11.5px/1.25 "Inter",sans-serif;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff}
.chan{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:rgba(255,255,255,.045);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);border-radius:14px;padding:16px 17px;margin-bottom:12px;transition:transform .28s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1),border-color .28s,background .28s}
.chan:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.chan:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 45%,transparent);background:rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
.chan__t{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;font-family:"Gazpacho",serif;font-weight:700;font-size:15.5px;color:#fff;margin:0 0 8px;line-height:1.1}
.chan__ic{flex-shrink:0;width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:9px;background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 16%,transparent);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--c) 38%,transparent);color:var(--c);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.chan__ic svg{width:16px;height:16px}
.chan__d{font-size:12.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.72);line-height:1.5;margin:0}
.smap__wrap{margin-top:20px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.14);padding-top:24px}
.smap__wrap-lbl{font:700 11px/1 "Inter",sans-serif;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);margin:0 0 16px;text-align:center}
.smap__wrap-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:18px}
.smap__note{margin-top:clamp(28px,3.4vw,40px);text-align:center;font-size:14.5px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.78)}
.smap__note b{color:#fff}
@media(max-width:1080px){
  .smap__grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
}
@media(max-width:640px){
  .smap__grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}

Use it when

  • After the why band, to show breadth across Ghar.tv before the packages
  • One pillar per product area, each with its own --c; channels say what the brand gets in one line
  • White text only on this dark ground

Avoid

  • More than five pillars. The grid is five columns and falls to three below 1080px
  • Prices or package names here; they belong in b2b-packages
  • A second dark band on the same page

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.pillar[style=--c]classColumn with .pillar__hd (dot and name) and .chan cards; --c tints dot, icon and hover border.
.chanclass.chan__t with .chan__ic, and .chan__d.
.smap__wrapslotLabel and two-up .smap__wrap-grid of .chan with their own --c.

Use it when

  • The first benefit band after the hero: three reasons, each a benefit to the brand
  • Exactly three cards; the tile colours come from :nth-child
  • Often followed in the same band by b2b-market

Avoid

  • Four or more cards. The grid is three columns and the colour rotation stops at three
  • Feature names as titles. Titles say what the brand gets
  • Stats inside the cards

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.why__headslotEyebrow, h2.disp and .lead, capped at 74ch.
.why__cardclass.why__ic (icon tile), .why__t, .why__d.

Legacy B2B comparison table

Paste Inline CSS: paste it too

A horizontally scrollable comparison table on the navy legacy B2B pages: a capability column, two alternative columns and a highlighted Ghar.tv column, with green ticks, faint crosses or short text in each cell.

Needscss2
Where
Used on 4 pages

brand-partners.html brokers.html buyers.html developers.html

Inline family. Source developers.html; byte-identical on buyers.html and brand-partners.html. brokers.html diverges (navy ground, min-width 760px, tighter th padding). Legacy B2B family: brokers.html, buyers.html, developers.html and brand-partners.html (/brokers, /buyers and /developers are linked from the off-canvas menu and footer; brand-partners.html is not linked). Each page is self-contained: Playfair Display, DM Sans and DM Mono on a navy ground, its own nav and footer, no styles.min.css. The paste needs that page base (:root tokens, section padding, .wrap, .eyebrow, .h), shown here in the preview style.

.cmp-t th{padding:16px 14px;text-align:center;font-family:var(--ff-d);font-size:14px;font-weight:600;border-bottom:2px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:var(--mute)}
.cmp-t th.ft{color:#fff;background:rgba(238,50,75,.08)}
.cmp-t td{padding:12px 14px;text-align:center;font-size:13px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.04);color:rgba(255,255,255,.72)}
.cmp-t td:first-child{text-align:left;font-weight:500;color:#fff;padding-left:20px}
.cmp-t td.ft{background:rgba(238,50,75,.04)}
.chk{color:var(--green);font-size:14px}
.x{color:rgba(255,255,255,.2);font-size:14px}

Use it when

  • Mid-page on a legacy B2B page to set Ghar.tv against the usual alternatives
  • Generic alternatives (an agency, doing it in-house), never a named competitor
  • Mark the Ghar.tv column with class="ft" on its th and every td

Avoid

  • Naming a competitor or a reference brand
  • Unverified claims in cells, such as launch-time figures
  • More than four columns; the table already scrolls below 720px

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.cmp-wrapclassScroll container; the table has min-width 720px.
th.ft / td.ftclassHighlighted Ghar.tv column.
.chk / .xclassGreen tick and faint cross glyphs.

Legacy B2B FAQ accordion

Paste Inline CSS: paste it too

A single-open FAQ list on the navy legacy B2B pages: Playfair question buttons with a square plus icon that turns red and rotates into a cross when open, and answers that expand by max-height.

Needscss2
Where
Used on 4 pages

brand-partners.html brokers.html buyers.html developers.html

Inline family. Source developers.html. Copies on brokers.html (navy ground, 320px cap), buyers.html (navy ground, adds .faq-tag.by and .faq-tag.ow audience tags) and brand-partners.html (navy ground, 860px list, different answer type) all diverge. The toggle script is inlined on each page. .faq-ic uses transition:all, and the question hover and open icon are brand red on non-CTA elements. Legacy B2B family: brokers.html, buyers.html, developers.html and brand-partners.html (/brokers, /buyers and /developers are linked from the off-canvas menu and footer; brand-partners.html is not linked). Each page is self-contained: Playfair Display, DM Sans and DM Mono on a navy ground, its own nav and footer, no styles.min.css. The paste needs that page base (:root tokens, section padding, .wrap, .eyebrow, .h), shown here in the preview style.
Preview 
<section class="faq" id="faq">
  <div class="wrap">
    <span class="eyebrow">Frequently asked questions</span>
    <h2 class="h">A plain <em>headline.</em></h2>
    <div class="faq-list">
      <div class="faq-i open"><button class="faq-q">A question the buyer asks?<div class="faq-ic">+</div></button><div class="faq-a"><p class="faq-a-in">A short, direct answer in one or two sentences.</p></div></div>
      <div class="faq-i"><button class="faq-q">A second question?<div class="faq-ic">+</div></button><div class="faq-a"><p class="faq-a-in">A short, direct answer in one or two sentences.</p></div></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
.faq{background:var(--navy-2)}
.faq-list{margin-top:32px;max-width:820px}
.faq-i{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07)}
.faq-q{width:100%;text-align:left;background:none;border:none;padding:18px 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;font-family:var(--ff-d);font-size:16px;font-weight:600;color:#fff;gap:20px;transition:color .2s}
.faq-q:hover{color:var(--red)}
.faq-ic{width:24px;height:24px;flex-shrink:0;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:15px;color:var(--mute);transition:all .3s}
.faq-i.open .faq-ic{background:var(--red);border-color:var(--red);color:#fff;transform:rotate(45deg)}
.faq-a{max-height:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .4s ease}
.faq-i.open .faq-a{max-height:360px}
.faq-a-in{padding:0 0 22px;font-size:14px;line-height:1.75;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65)}
document.querySelectorAll('.faq-q').forEach(b=>{
    b.addEventListener('click',()=>{
      const item=b.parentElement;
      const open=item.classList.contains('open');
      document.querySelectorAll('.faq-i').forEach(i=>i.classList.remove('open'));
      if(!open)item.classList.add('open');
    });
  });

Use it when

  • Near the end of a legacy B2B page, before the closing band, id="faq"
  • First item .open so one answer shows on load
  • Short direct answers; the open panel caps at 360px of text

Avoid

  • New pages. Portal pages use the shared accordion component
  • Answers with unverified figures such as city counts or ticket sizes
  • Long answers; they clip at the max-height cap

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.faq-i.openstateExpanded item: red rotated icon, answer max-height 360px.
.faq-qclassButton with the question text and .faq-ic.
.faq-a > .faq-a-inslotAnswer paragraph.

Use it when

  • Last section of the dark vertical, id="brief"
  • Open with [data-vw-brief-open] or window.vwBriefOpen(trigger); the page also routes the masthead [data-brief-open] pill here in the capture phase

  • Margins on controls inside the fieldsets; the form flex gap spaces them
  • Two .jm-btn in a row without the .vwf-nav sizing
  • Calling gharBriefOpen; that is the design-project brief

Use it when

  • Only on an earned-dark vertical: a page where the dark ground is the product, as with the film studio page
  • One --vw-bloom per section, coloured by meaning (turmeric the brand light, terracotta launch heat, indigo the measured cut, sage place, aubergine the virtual)
  • Alternate plain and .vw-sec--raised sections; add .vw-sec--defer only to raised sections, whose panel clips anyway
  • A warm key in one corner and a cool fill in the opposite one across neighbouring sections for depth

Avoid

  • Any other page. The portal canvas is white; a dark moment elsewhere is a contained card
  • .vw-sec--defer on a section with a bloom. content-visibility clips paint at the padding box and draws a hard seam down both sides
  • Animated light: no animation, filter or mix-blend-mode on blooms or textures
  • Theme pigments at full strength on the dark ground

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.vw-sec / .vw-sec--raisedclassSection wrapper; raised wraps content in .vw-sec__inner (with .panel-bleed).
.vw-sec--defermodifiercontent-visibility:auto with a 720px intrinsic size.
.vw-bloom--tr / --tl / --brclassStatic radial light; colour from --vw-bloom.
.vw-grid-texclassHairline grid at about 3%, masked to fade downward.
.vw-eyebrow / .vw-h2 / .vw-lead / .vw-monoclassSection head type.

Use it when

  • Claims backed by how the work is done, not by numbers

Avoid

  • Cards or icons; this section is type-led

      <h1 class="vw-reveal__h" id="vwRevealH" data-words>One statement of what the studio is, long enough to fill word by word as the reader scrolls.</h1>
      <div class="vw-reveal__foot" data-reveal-foot>
        <span class="vw-mono">Keep scrolling</span>
        <span class="vw-mono" aria-hidden="true">&#8595;</span>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

Use it when

  • First section of an earned-dark vertical, under body.nav-dark nav-over-hero so the masthead floats on it as glass
  • Poster JPG in the markup, no <source> and no src: videoworks.js picks WebM, MP4 1080p or 720p on idle from viewport, Save-Data and connection
  • keep-transform on the section, or the portal touch-hover rule zeroes the stage translate on tap
  • A looping video with its audio track stripped, encoded for the size it is drawn at

Avoid

  • Animating filter, box-shadow or border-radius in the timeline; fade a sibling overlay instead
  • A tween without an explicit duration on the scrubbed timeline
  • A hard-coded cover scale; it is computed per refresh from the stage size
  • Presenting atmosphere footage as client work

API

NameTypeWhat it does
#vwScrollidScroll trigger for the timeline and the pause-when-offscreen observer.
.vw-stageclassScaled wrapper; GSAP owns its -50% centring.
.vw-videoclassSource attached by videoworks.js on idle.
[data-words]attributeHeading split into .vw-rw word spans.
[data-reveal-foot]attributeFoot that fades in at the end of the scroll.

    <path d="M21 2v6h-6"/><path d="M3 12a9 9 0 0 1 15-6.7L21 8"/>
    <path d="M3 22v-6h6"/><path d="M21 12a9 9 0 0 1-15 6.7L3 16"/>
    </svg>
    <span>One sentence on how the last step feeds the first.</span>
  </p>
</div>

Use it when

  • Inside a .vw-sec--raised panel for a process that repeats
  • Exactly six steps; the grid is explicit 1 / 2 / 3 columns
  • Short verbs as step titles

Avoid

  • Per-cell borders; the 1px grid gap is the hairline
  • The lit ring on these cells. A ring on every cell of a hairline grid draws a lattice, so they take the wash only
  • A step count that leaves an orphan row

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.vw-loop__stepclass__n, __h, __p.
.vw-loop__closeclassClosing row: cycle svg plus span.

<div class="vw-svc vw-spot">
  <article class="vw-card vw-card--turmeric" data-reveal>
    <span class="vw-card__n vw-mono">01</span>
    <span class="vw-card__icon" aria-hidden="true">
      <svg class="vw-card__icon-svg" viewBox="0 0 200 200" aria-hidden="true">
      <mask id="vwIcon1" maskUnits="userSpaceOnUse" x="0" y="0" width="200" height="200">
      <path d="M 100,26 L 176,82 L 176,170 L 24,170 L 24,82 Z" fill="#fff" stroke="#fff" stroke-width="28" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <g transform="translate(68 90) scale(2.6667)" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><rect x="3" y="5" width="18" height="14" rx="2.5"/><path d="M8.5 5v14M15.5 5v14"/></g>
      </mask>
      <rect width="200" height="200" fill="currentColor" mask="url(#vwIcon1)"/>
      </svg>
    </span>
    <h3 class="vw-card__h">Service name</h3>
    <p class="vw-card__p">Two sentences on what this service makes and what it is for.</p>
    <ul class="vw-card__list">
      <li>Deliverable</li>
      <li>Deliverable</li>
      <li>Deliverable</li>
    </ul>
  </article>
</div>

Use it when

  • Six services, one tone each, assigned by meaning
  • Icon: the silhouette and glyph in ONE 200-unit viewBox, glyph masked out, 64 units centred at (100,122) at most; each silhouette used once
  • .vw-spot on the grid so videoworks.js writes the pointer position once per grid
  • Unique mask ids per card

Avoid

  • auto-fit columns; the grid is explicit 1 / 2 / 3 so six cards never leave orphans
  • A house glyph inside a house silhouette
  • Scaling the glyph up; scale the tile
  • The torch glow on a viewport-sized layer

API

NameTypeWhat it does
.vw-card--turmeric / terracotta / indigo / sage / aubergine / sandmodifierSets --vw-tone for the corner light, hairline and icon.
.vw-spotclassTorch glow container; JS sets --vw-mx / --vw-my and toggles .is-lit.
.vw-card__icon-svgclassSilhouette with a masked glyph.

Use it when

  • Where the work lands: link each surface the output is published or placed on
  • Product names stand alone, with one line on what the work gets there
  • Whole card is the link

Avoid

  • External links
  • More than four; the row is four columns on desktop
  • A card without a real destination page
